subject: Will you help Alexandria build the progressive leadership needed in Congress to push the Democratic Party forward?

body:
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20221026-3533-header&t=1&akid=3533%2E2526796%2EqIbowg)
In order to maintain our majority after this election and grow the Democratic party for the long term, we must take on corporate power.
For too long, Democrats have been too shy and too scared to confront corporations head on. That fear shows up when we talk about inflation and oil prices, and how we address issues like guaranteed health care.
While a key part of Republican ideology is to support rich “Corporate America,” Democrats are supposed to be the party of working people.
**Alexandria has been very clear: ending corporate influence in our politics is necessary to support working people and bring more people into our party.** From challenging big parma to big tech, fossil fuel executives, and beyond – Alexandria has never shied away from speaking truth to power.
But our campaign finance system is designed to disadvantage campaigns like ours who refuse corporate PAC money. So, Alexandria and our team rely on grassroots donations to fight back against corporate-funded attacks. [Can you chip in $6 to our campaign to help us keep Alexandria in Congress where she can take on corporate power and push our party forward?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221026.3Pih6i&refcode=em20221026-3533-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3533%2E2526796%2EqIbowg)
**[Contribute $6](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221026.3Pih6i&refcode=em20221026-3533-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=3533%2E2526796%2EqIbowg)**
This fundamental reality is clear for all: Our system is not working for working people.
Big Oil has already made over $100 billion gouging consumers at the pump.1 They plan to use that money to help elect Republicans who will undermine Biden’s clean energy agenda and keep us addicted to fossil fuels.2
Prices are going up, and much of that has to do with the consolidation of market power and the fact that the most basic goods – housing, food, etc. – are concentrated into corporate oligopolies. Huge corporations are price gouging _just because they can_.
[That is not economic justice. But we can fight to keep leaders like Alexandria in Congress who will lead the charge for an economy that works for all and bring other progressive leaders with her. Can you donate $6 to help us do that in 2023?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20221026.3Pih6i&refcode=em20221026-3533-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=3533%2E2526796%2EqIbowg)
In solidarity,
Team AOC

body:

# [](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/144?t=2&akid=1133%2E61531%2E6ILmcD)
Hey team,
Peter here. I just got off the debate stage, and I hope I made you proud.
This debate made clear just how high the stakes of this election are. And Vermont deserves a senator who will fight for them, not special interests. As I made clear in this debate: I’m ready to work across the aisle to deliver on the things everyday people care about most — lowering the cost of living, combating climate change, protecting reproductive rights. **We heard a very different message from my opponent.**
**But the Senate is up for grabs, and we can’t take anything for granted. Our entire progressive agenda depends on winning this open seat and keeping the Senate blue.[ So I have to ask: Can you chip in $3 or anything you can to protect our Senate majority?](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/4746?t=3&akid=1133%2E61531%2E6ILmcD)**
**Tonight, Vermonters heard two very different visions for our future. And in 13 days, we'll learn which vision they’ve chosen with their votes. We have to do everything in our power to win their support.**
There’s hope for a better future, but it starts with ensuring we defend and protect our Democratic Senate majority. National MAGA money is coming into Vermont to attack me in order to boost my opponent and win back control. **With the Senate split 50/50 on a knife’s edge, we can’t afford to lose momentum during the final stretch of our campaign. The stakes are just too high, and too many Vermonters are relying on us to deliver results.**
[**Right now, I’m counting on your support to help capture tonight’s momentum and take this movement all the way. | | Team Jensen needs your help now more than ever. This race is close. Walz is hiding from voters because of his failed leadership. Now is the time to get in the game. Join us in our efforts of reaching voters across the state.

Here's how you can help.

_**PHONE BANKING**_

Our next phone banking opportunity is tomorrow. Will you join us?

__**Make sure to bring your own device. You can bring a laptop, iPad, tablet or smart phone. Also, headphones will really help.**__

To schedule a shift, fill out the form below with all the times you are available.

_**WHERE:**_

Filament Workplace (enter the Re/Max doors and go to the 2nd floor)
14451 Hwy 7
Minnetonka, MN 55345

_**WHEN:**_

Thursday, October 27, 5:00-8:00 PM (food and beverages provided)
Saturday, October 29, noon-3:00 PM
Tuesday, November 1, 5:00-8:00 PM
Thursday, November 3, 5:00-8:00 PM
Saturday, November 5, noon-3:00 PM
Monday, November 7, 5:00-8:00 PM
**[RSVP HERE](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=0977887843&e=33b11688c1)**
_**CALLING FROM HOME**_

We have an incredible system that allows for people to make calls from home. I know that not everyone lives close enough to our phone banking location or are available during the scheduled shifts. BUT YOU CAN STILL MAKE CALLS! Fill out the form below and someone from our team will reach out to get you set up to make calls. _It's that simple!_
[SIGN UP HERE](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=339d192201&e=33b11688c1)
_**Going Door to Door**_
_**Check out opportunities to volunteer near you.**_
* __**Saturday, October 29 | Lit Drop in Inver Grove**__ | Time: 9:45 AM-12:00 PM | Location: AMC Inver Grove 16, 5567 Bishop Ave, Inver Grove Heights, MN 55076 | RSVP by clicking [HERE](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=ec49804c59&e=33b11688c1).
* __**Saturday, October 29 | Lit Drop with SD49 in Eden Prairie**__ | Time: 9:30 AM | Location: 13001 Technology Drive, Eden Prairie, 55344.

You can find Jensen literature at these offices across the state.
[](https://DrScottJensen.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0a6593cc14b86d0dcb3944b28&id=949ec809d6&e=33b11688c1)

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter,

If you think having Rand Paul and Dr. Oz in the room with you and your
doctor while you’re viewing your ultrasound is disgusting, I should be
your candidate for Senate in Kentucky.

Rand Paul and Dr. Oz have said for decades that they want to outlaw
abortion at the local, state, and federal levels.

Now that Roe v. Wade has been overturned, they’re going to do just that --
and thrust themselves (and the rest of the government) into your doctor’s
office and your personal business.

Let me be clear: The government should not be in the business of enforcing
personal beliefs on others.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18797?t=1001&akid=2669%2E346206%2Eqvryiw ]Chip in $20 or more now to help me defeat Rand Paul and preserve
reproductive freedom for the women of Kentucky.

Peter, my mom had two ectopic pregnancies -- she's told her
story of nearly dying because she couldn't get the health care she
needed.

This is a complicated issue. And we can’t allow the government to decide
who gets health care and who doesn’t.

[ https://act.charlesbooker.org/go/18797?t=1002&akid=2669%2E346206%2Eqvryiw ]Please consider pitching in $20 or more to help make sure every
Kentuckian knows my view in the run-up to the election on November 8th.

Thanks for your support,

Charles

The race for the House is coming into clear view. With just **13 days until Election Day** , the races that are going to make or break the projected Republican House majority are really taking shape. Earlier this month, _**Politico**_ wrote that “ _**212 seats are now at least leaning toward Republicans, compared with 198 leaning toward Democrats**_.”

And to the surprise of no one on my team, but perhaps to some disenchanted political hacks in D.C., t**hey even included a note about my race near the top of the article**.

“ _**Two open seats in Oregon have moved from “Likely Democratic” to “Lean Democratic,” despite double-digit Biden 2020 margins in each.**_ ”

[** SUPPORT OUR UNDECIDED VOTER FUND ➞ **](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=d939213964f04083bbd9c64626f5e9a0&_e=-VUsXPr-auvgbWd-AOW439AxR1_M2jsN17yDhSNLsee_DX0Veu24VwEl8RpRlBs_8fGqebZLsEaVj5bK17bvjUNpd1OKsBy-c0vta_ABhFuPrWTmzJMX1ikOTGOHFWchyUAJDDxezQEKC4PGvhhaILECHrSx8BLzfPXhdu5NJVdUyYFf1K6pSONIsHKMM-h65RvnpXu5-cWxjupkeGWQHuaEf2JM5o4bRwR9znO26F13pARwspUAgdIIt895eICv-Kn56-X27w3-cIahw7h8DbbTW6_LhpbMfpMNiiZtb6TzbHeYA03e7nZvEnQct3g574ihqAHbS3x1zeh9KezmBBIMxHwTA0TQ6h4VEUzeNZ3ZC0XMJ9IgvuANElaw6_XtIr30Co-h0CSObgca5rOIh993uEgv918QJqDyDWBoJDE%3D)
The competitive nature of my race, and the race in the neighboring district, speaks to the abysmal job Democrats have done since they took over Washington two years ago. While DEMS have a slight advantage in Oregon, it’s not insurmountable. **All you must do is look to the governor’s race which is a pure TOSSUP**.

If we’re going to flip this district for the first time since the mid-1970s, **we need to reach every undecided voter.** Here are a few key reasons we’re asking you to **[chip in $5](http://links.alekskarlatosforcongress.com/u/click?_t=7e7d86e0b42141418fdbf0bb715c41e9&_m=d939213964f04083bbd9c64626f5e9a0&_e=-VUsXPr-auvgbWd-AOW439AxR1_M2jsN17yDhSNLsee_DX0Veu24VwEl8RpRlBs_8fGqebZLsEaVj5bK17bvjUNpd1OKsBy-c0vta_ABhFuPrWTmzJMX1ikOTGOHFWchyUAJDDxezQEKC4PGvhhaILECHrSx8BLzfPXhdu5NJVdUyYFf1K6pSONIsHKMM-h65RvnpXu5-cWxjupkeGWQHuaEf2JM5o4bRwR9znO26F13pARwspUAgdIIt895eICvQn1nj2QdEcerFPErf-N45oSYETvCI-6nitwyKl56dJ8SWp9becoUlzpnn3xQApZFrGBn6dYzh-r0bLZze4IcCpuofzdt0Wbkqa5F4ZY-ZPMgFHhAHUCf_-psqaOjPrsOUw8J6jUySM709rI-GchFZj9T-xaN-P6eRczNIk48YhM%3D)** to our voter outreach fund today.
* Democrats outnumber Republicans by 40,000 registered voters, thanks in large part to extreme gerrymander Oregon Democrats put in place last year

* Unaffiliated voters make up the biggest voting in my district by large margins. More than 150,000 voters neither belong to the Democrat or Republican Party. **To win our race, we must win this voting bloc.**

* According to the most recent internal poll, **some 4% of voters remain undecided.** These voters are the voters that will ultimately decide the race. It’s so important that we win these voters over before voters start casting ballots on October 19th.

**Please help me and my team reach as many undecided voters as we can over the next 13 days.**

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

clean_body: We need to pick up the pace ASAP or this race could be over... | | Fellow American, I wouldn’t be reaching out to you so frantically if this wasn’t a dire situation ... but my Democrat-endorsed opponent is outraising my campaign and we’re less than two weeks away from Election Day. Now is not the time to fall behind - too much is at stake in this election for us to lose. I called my team and asked them what I can do to pick up the pace. Their response? REACH OUT TO YOU, Fellow American. If I win – Republicans will win back the Senate majority. If I lose - well, you know. We can’t let that happen. The Democrats are determined to win in Utah. Chuck Schumer knows a WIN here is the ONLY WAY the left can hold their majority. My campaign is being outraised and time is running out before Election Day. This is the time when critical ad placements are made and without money in the bank - my opponent will be able to reach more voters at a crucial stage in this race. Help me win and help Republicans take back the Senate majority. I’m counting on hearing from you. For America, Mike Lee MEET MIKE: | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property. After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court. Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah. | | | ---|---|--- | Paid for by Friends of Mike Lee, Inc. PO Box 1537 Salt Lake City, UT 84110

Friend -- I know this is last minute, but I called some friends today and asked if they'd be willing to be part of our Defend Democracy Get Out the Vote Rally on Thursday night -- and they said "Let's do it!" * **Col. Terry Virts** , NASA Astronaut
* **Michael Fanone** , Former Officer of the Metropolitan Police Department of DC
* **Evan McMullin** , Candidate for U.S. Senator for Utah

What are the current threats? How do we best identify and support pro-democracy candidates? What power does each individual, regardless of background or walk of life, hold? How can we channel that power at the ballot box? What really matters here on Earth and how do we pursue it together? We'll explore those questions and have a great time. | [](https://www.country1st.com/gotv_rally?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_rally_nd&n=4 "RSVP: Defend Democracy Rally") [RSVP: Defend Democracy Rally](https://www.country1st.com/gotv_rally?e=4ee51f15644d695f1e1564c20f506a7d&utm_source=country1st&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=gotv_rally_nd&n=4)

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

name: Adam Laxalt
subject: Where I come from
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Laxalt for Senate
body:
This is my story [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c0912%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=aiQFbs%2bO0AMKDjQhlkuK1A&sysid=1)
This is my story

| |
---
| | | Hi, I’m Adam Laxalt, and this is my story.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c48662%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=j7NDQCDCIi%2bsvsUlwdXfQw&sysid=1 "Adam 1")
---

I didn’t know who my father was. I was born to a single mother in the 1970s. She was in her early 20s, had no college degree, and faced enormous pressure to not bring me into this world. But through faith, she chose to give me the chance to live, and I’ll be forever grateful for that opportunity.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c48663%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=vs6RJdIuEkMXt9KRseqDjA&sysid=1 "Adam 2")
---

Although my childhood wasn’t always easy, my experiences shaped me into the person I am today. I learned the power of faith and the importance of family and community. Without these things, there is no way I could’ve accomplished everything that I have.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c48664%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=uJmAHBnLJ2Hf2GrO6oAS1g&sysid=1 "Adam 3")
---

After 9/11 attacks, I joined the US Navy - I always knew I wanted to serve my country, but after that date, I knew I needed to act. As a Naval Officer and Iraq Veteran, I served in detainee operations and assisted in the detention and prosecution of more than 20,000 detainees.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c48675%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4PrNKXnrj1v38ACFZdCW8g&sysid=1 "Adam 4")
---

Nothing made me prouder than keeping my fellow Americans safe by assisting with the prosecution of thousands of war criminals and terrorists.

After finishing my active duty service, I decided to get married and start my family. But I knew I wasn’t done serving and protecting our country. In 2015, I became Nevada’s Attorney General, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c48676%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=tGyhVx31%2b%2b%2fQ0QSVB6hxAw&sysid=1 "Adam 5")
---

Today I live in Reno with my wife, Jaime, and four kids. They’re the reason I’m running for US Senate.

I believe our country is fighting a battle between good and evil, and right now it seems the wrong side is winning. But I believe America is worth saving, and I know you do too.

_**[That’s why I’m asking you to join my team and fight with me to restore conservative leadership in Washington.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c48677%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=IU%2fLYdKmbDB1sOdJ7%2beiVA&sysid=1 "That’s why I’m asking you to join my team and
fight with me to restore conservative leadership in Washington.")**_ Together we can take this country back, but we must act now. Please, step up now before it’s too late.

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM LAXALT](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c48678%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZRpOhDsJ27ZLHdNNDgJnKg&sysid=1 "JOIN TEAM LAXALT")
---

I know with your support, we can save this country we both love so much.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Adam Laxalt

---
| |
* * *

---
| [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c48679%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=ZSpkXBSmCDaqvvE5KO%2bZug&sysid=1 "Nevada Gif")
---

This is Adam Laxalt, and I’m **FIRED UP**!
My race here in Nevada has been upgraded to the #1**PICK-UP** opportunity for Republicans! This is the ONLY seat we need to win to flip the Senate **RED**! I know we can **WIN** this race, but I need you to help to make that happen. _**[Can you please chip in one more time before election day and help SECURE VICTORY?](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c48670%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=O4GgdWmq%2fCskHkiZ4s6GaA&sysid=1 "Can you please chip in one more time before

---

---

Adam is Fmr. Naval Officer and Iraq War veteran. He is the**ONLY veteran** in the race, and has been endorsed by _Pres. Trump, Gov. DeSantis, and Sen. Cruz. _

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjMyMzA5In0/5MJCAF-6MBwoxRjJSnCoyw)
---
Dear Friend, The online sexual exploitation of children has risen at an alarming rate in recent years. Internet predators and traffickers have easy and anonymous access to vulnerable and unsuspecting children, who often fall into the predator's grooming trap and are seduced into sending sexual images of themselves. Online grooming is one of the many tactics used by predators to create child sex abuse material (CSAM), previously referred to as child pornography. Their suffering is not a one-time crime. Instead, any time the depiction of their abuse is sold, shared, posted online, bartered or used privately for a consumer's sexual gratification, the crime against the victim is repeated. In 2021, more than 29.3 million CyberTipline reports were made containing over 84.9 million images, videos and other content related to suspected child sexual exploitation, an increase of 35% from 2020. Sadly, millions of children and families have suffered while multi-billion-dollar electronic service providers refuse to do their part to keep kids safe on their platforms. Big Tech continues to avoid accountability and legal recourse by claiming "blanket immunity" from any responsibility. _Instead of protecting children, greedy internet platforms knowingly allow minors to be abused and exploited - That_ '_s why Enough Is Enough (EIE) strongly advocates for the passage of the bipartisan bill, Earn It Act (S. 3538) which is being cosponsored by 22 Senators and is pending in both the Senate and the House of Representatives.__ _ If enacted, this critical piece of bi-partisan legislation will remove blanket immunity for social media and technology companies that knowingly facilitate the distribution of CSAM on its platforms. This priority bill gives victims of CSAM the chance to restore their privacy and get justice from those who facilitated the crimes committed against them. **Together, we must urge Congress to act immediately to protect our kids from devastating online risks that can ruin their lives.** [**Let Congress know that immediate action must be taken to end Big Tech** '**s** "**blanket immunity," and stop these abusive crimes against children by signing our petition today.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjMyMzA5In0/QVqU-hN-j2KPeTJOCr2h2g)
---
[**Sign Today: End Online Child Exploitation**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjMyMzA5In0/W0MKUswOmseE6BFIfs1fZQ)
---
Due to record number of child sex abuse material distributed on the internet, legislative initiatives are needed now more than ever to hold Big Tech accountable for knowingly allowing the facilitation of this content on its platforms. Millions of these cases of abuse go unidentified and unreported by the Big Tech platforms that host them because there are so few consequences when these companies look the other way, thanks to "blanket immunity" from criminal prosecution. This crime flourishes as profit-hungry Big Tech companies capitalize on the multi-billion-dollar supply-and-demand chain for images and videos of innocent children, many as young as infants and toddlers, being sexually abused and often violently raped. Along with your support, EIE stands ready to end the epidemic of online sexual exploitation of minors, and to make the internet safer for children and families. _But our legislators need to hear YOUR voice. _ [**Sign this petition urging Congress to end Big Tech** '**s** "**blanket immunity," and hold Internet Service Providers legally liable if they continue allowing predatory exploitation and abuse of children online.**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjMyMzA5In0/fI8NV1NtH_zYTqwyKgobqg)
---
[**Sign Today: End Online Child Exploitation**](http://trk.faithandlibertymail._c291cmNlX2NvZGU9RkFMUjMyMzA5In0/yijwsST875tlXyII2EGZ6w)
---

| | | Friend, my name is Adam Laxalt. You may have never heard of me, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I was born in Reno, Nevada and raised by a single mother. Growing up, it was just me and my mom. I have always aspired to be as much of a leader as she was.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zttsmh682qf1d8868v4fj6jnfkn287vsrj5k94j8_ "Adam 1")
---

I know that real leadership means standing up for what you believe in and standing up for people everywhere. But I was headed down the wrong path in life.

As a teenager, I suffered from addiction. But the people who loved me got me help. I turned my life around, and that taught me helping others gives life meaning. That's why I volunteered to serve in the Navy after 9/11 and volunteered to serve in the Iraq War.

---
| | | [SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zt839nsao5vrbfbgjld3633u28a26jelft4l5u4g_ "SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT")
---

Serving our country as a Navy Officer in Iraq was an honor.

While I was serving, my unit was in charge of over 20,000 detainees to keep American troops safe. This was one of the most challenging experiences of my life, but also the most rewarding.

_Knowing that I was on the front lines of protecting the country I love so dearly is something that I will continue to cherish for the rest of my life. _

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z42dohdi4jdbvlfdo9jr0u48npb9nd00291kjvv8_ "Adam 2")

After returning from Iraq, I felt the call to serve my state again and went on to be Nevada's Attorney General and top law enforcement officer. I fought hard to serve the people of Nevada, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

Now I'm taking on a huge challenge for our country: running for U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zqe4p0jv5rrhfs7h3ribf059dae8juiv4ec1stq0_ "Adam 3")

My race is **officially the #1 race in the country** , and all eyes are on me. The Democrats have already raised 76 MILLION to destroy my campaign.

Unlike my opponent, I rely on grassroots supporters like you to keep my campaign running.

I know I will be great leader for the people of Nevada, and for the people of America.

Now that you know my story, _**[will you please chip in to help me continue it into the halls of the United States Capitol?](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zloc4j1b9mileqkek1bhbk23hq82fbrgg9keu3mo_ "will you please chip in to help me continue it into the halls of the United States Capitol?")**_

Adam Laxalt

Peter,

I know you're busy, but I need just a few minutes of your time.

__**[This is why I'm running.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61740958:JouQrNGdN:m:1:3253819041:6FA647440008DAB92677599F7BA761EF:r "This is why
I’m running.")**__

I grew up on a small farm in Washington.

We didn't have much, but I learned the value of hard work at a young age. I learned _responsibility_. That is something that political elites will never understand.

As a former triage nurse, I have always been passionate about serving others in my community.

However, everything was tested when a suicide bomber in Iraq permanently blinded my husband, Scotty, and I was told his service was over.
_**The suicide bomber may have taken my husband's vision, but he didn 't take away our determination and drive for service over self.**_
That's how I found myself running against a 30-year Democrat incumbent because we deserve better.

With empty grocery shelves and unprecedented crime, I couldn't sit on the sidelines any longer.

_**[This country is worth serving and sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61740958:JouQrNGdN:m:1:3253819041:6FA647440008DAB92677599F7BA761EF:r "This country is worth serving and
sacrificing for, but I need YOUR endorsement to continue my fight!")**_

I'm not asking for money. _Today, all I 'm asking for is your endorsement. _

Tiffany Smiley

name: Connor Boyack
subject: Debunking 40 popular political and economic myths
body:
There’s this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true. It’s a narrative that you’ll often see

| | | [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9ecb1o4frqpifg1i6kl5jld423tgo08hhti52n0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3hm1ob1cdh2bs)
---
| | Dear Friend, There's this notion nowadays that just because an idea is popular, it must be true.

It's a narrative that you'll often see pushed by a dysfunctional media or toxic culture. And as long as the idea is considered "correct" by the "right" people like TV talking heads, celebrities, or the masses on social media, the general public believes it.

That's why the Libertas Institute published this eBook in our Tuttle Twins series: **[_The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths._](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z9j4iimt37nj5p1a6g749fd0cmvn6gi06ei34k8g_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3hm1ob1cdh2bs)**
---
| [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2ziuvp1mhl8lojr3i42dqr14q3i7djq80h5d87bno_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3hm1ob1cdh2bs)
---
| | And today, we want to send a copy to your inbox for FREE.

Inside this important eBook, you'll get a clear analysis of some of the biggest political and economic myths infecting our world today like:
* Overpopulation is destroying the world
* Global climate change can be reversed by law
* Capitalism creates winners and losers
* Socialism helps the poor

You can get your free copy using this secure link:

**[https://act.libertasutah.org/tt-the-tuttle-rebuttals](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zra8cbj96u0fqt2bov700uv5kesckdnt3tpgbrd8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3hm1ob1cdh2bs)**

I'd also love for you to share this book with at least 5 people you know--especially any children in your family. My hope is that they will enjoy the same benefits you do when you read this book. And then, we can crush these myths once and for all.

Please use this link to get instant access to your free copy of _**[The Tuttle Rebuttals: 40 Responses to Popular Political and Economic Myths](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z6gbaonma71sn6uc5lvc22ltvjtdn478mkou4310_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3hm1ob1cdh2bs)**_ today!
Thank you,

Connor Boyack
Author, Tuttle Twins
Founder, Libertas Institute

Today, I’m writing to let you know that we’ve produced a limited number of DVD box sets of our “Constitution 101” course
| | | This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zhvvrt88johepcsbn734dqegpgsuct6vbrg849d8_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3hm2o76c5h2bs) Dear Fellow American, [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zp7krpr1kf5ms6kaspfanhpf2q7klq2cq6080te0_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3hm2o76c5h2bs) I hope you’re having a great day so far. Today, I’m writing to let you know that we’ve produced a limited number of DVD box sets of our “Constitution 101” course, and I’d like you to have a copy. The course features Hillsdale College’s world-renowned faculty. It teaches the original design and purpose of the Constitution, the challenges it faced during the Civil War, and how it has been undermined for over a century by progressivism and liberalism. It concludes by setting forth how limited government under the Constitution might be revived. “Constitution 101” is modeled after the course that all Hillsdale students are required to take, and this DVD box set is your opportunity to experience it for yourself. I hope you take advantage of this offer, and I have included a secure link for you here: [**https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/constitution-101-dvd/**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zeht3kdedg9fe5c517ifh367a8qcdgm3fjs9m4bo_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3hm2o76c5h2bs) As you know, Hillsdale takes no government funding, even indirectly in the form of student grants or loans. As I mentioned above, supplies of the new “Constitution 101” DVD box set are limited, so I hope you’ll reserve your copy today. Sincerely, Bill Gray Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth—Defending Liberty since 1844

Hi, I'm former Congresswoman Tulsi Gabbard - please take a moment to read this entire message. It's critical to the future of our country.

Recently, I announced that I am leaving the Democratic Party, and I want to take a moment to tell you why.

I believe in a government of the people, by the people, and for the people. Unfortunately, today's Democratic Party does not. Instead, it stands for a government of, by, and for the powerful elite.

I love our country. Our God-given rights of freedom, life, and liberty enshrined in our Constitution and Bill of Rights are my inspiration. I answered the call to serve and took an oath, dedicating my life to supporting and defending those freedoms, both in uniform and in public office.

**[Now, my mission continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That's why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61741395:JP-kANGNC:m:1:3331421248:ADC29135616D24F6594642413A4BE6A5:r "Now, my mission
continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That’s why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin. ")**

He just told me he is coming up on his biggest fundraising deadline and is still $4,457 short of his goal. **[Can you chip in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61741395:JP-kANGNC:m:1:3331421248:ADC29135616D24F6594642413A4BE6A5:r "Can you chip in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?")**

Your donation will send a strong message to Democratic Party elites that we are tired of their constant attacks on our freedoms.

Let's remember the ideals our founders laid out for us. Draw inspiration from their hopes for this country, and take action to bring about a government that is truly of, by, and for the people.

If you can't stomach the direction that so-called woke Democratic Party ideologues are taking our country, I invite you to join me.

**[A donation of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61741395:JP-kANGNC:m:1:3331421248:ADC29135616D24F6594642413A4BE6A5:r "A donation of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders. _This is a longer, personal note from Marcy. We hope you’ll take a moment to read it from beginning to end and hear why this community and this fight mean so much to Marcy. If you don’t have time,**[please click here to make a contribution of $5 ahead of our end-of-month deadline, and help keep Marcy fighting for Northern Ohio families.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53426352/375393547/2035135873?refcode=EM_FR_221027FRAM_N_MK_45DA_9_NG_N_L1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTY1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTNjMDhmMS1mNzU1LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=LFgUW0qtKBUfwO4vGnX_6V20p0N4AIv3Xmz4E8LGWww=)**_ Friend,

I want to talk to you about my house. No, not the House of Representatives, but my childhood home in Toledo, where I still reside today.

Where I come from, a house still means a lot. It represents family and the stake we hold in our community. My grandparents were Polish immigrants choosing to lay down roots and raise their families in Toledo. They instilled diligence and duty into my parents - mom worked in a spark plug factory where she served on the UAW organizing committee, and dad retired from Jeep and ran a small family grocery store.

I got my first lesson in economic injustice as a child when a meat supplier refused to sell my father high-quality beef for his store. I witnessed my father fight for the right of his working-class customers to have the same quality products as everyone else, and the supplier relented. At that moment, my path was laid out.

As the house was passed down, so too were the values of hard work and community service. Because my parents invested in me, I was the first person in my family to go to college. I worked in urban planning and development, but when my community asked me to step up and run for Congress, I answered the call.

I tell this story to illustrate the point that this district deserves a representative in Congress who understands its unique needs. I have lived in this district, in the same house, for most of my life. My constituents are friends and neighbors, and I am honored to serve and fight for them.

Governing is not always glamorous. Crafting, amending, and passing legislation is a grueling process that requires the dedication and patience my parents instilled in me. It involves identifying the needs of a community and then fighting hard to bring back the resources needed to help the region thrive.

From funding for job training in our schools or constructing the World War II Memorial to securing funding for a vegetable garden at a senior housing complex and holding back the Asian carp’s invasion of the Great Lakes, no project can be too daunting.

I love this district like I love my house. My work is both challenging and fulfilling. It is the highest honor of my life to serve our community. I will always put forth my very best effort for the people of Northern Ohio because they deserve nothing less.

**[This November, though, I face a tough battle to keep serving this community in Congress. The GOP is throwing everything they have at us, and I need your help. Can you contribute $5 ahead of our October 31 end-of-month deadline so that we can continue investing in one another and help our home community reach its full clean_body: Not the House of Representatives, but my childhood home in Toledo. | | = This is a longer, personal note from Marcy. We hope you’ll take a moment to read it from beginning to end and hear why this community and this fight mean so much to Marcy. If you don’t have time,= Friend, I want to talk to you about my house. No, not the House of Representatives, but my childhood home in Toledo, where I still reside today. Where I come from, a house still means a lot. It represents family and the stake we hold in our community. My grandparents were Polish immigrants choosing to lay down roots and raise their families in Toledo. They instilled diligence and duty into my parents - mom worked in a spark plug factory where she served on the UAW organizing committee, and dad retired from Jeep and ran a small family grocery store. I got my first lesson in economic injustice as a child when a meat supplier refused to sell my father high-quality beef for his store. I witnessed my father fight for the right of his working-class customers to have the same quality products as everyone else, and the supplier relented. At that moment, my path was laid out. As the house was passed down, so too were the values of hard work and community service. Because my parents invested in me, I was the first person in my family to go to college. I worked in urban planning and development, but when my community asked me to step up and run for Congress, I answered the call. I tell this story to illustrate the point that this district deserves a representative in Congress who understands its unique needs. I have lived in this district, in the same house, for most of my life. My constituents are friends and neighbors, and I am honored to serve and fight for them. Governing is not always glamorous. Crafting, amending, and passing legislation is a grueling process that requires the dedication and patience my parents instilled in me. It involves identifying the needs of a community and then fighting hard to bring back the resources needed to help the region thrive. From funding for job training in our schools or constructing the World War II Memorial to securing funding for a vegetable garden at a senior housing complex and holding back the Asian carp’s invasion of the Great Lakes, no project can be too daunting. I love this district like I love my house. My work is both challenging and fulfilling. It is the highest honor of my life to serve our community. I will always put forth my very best effort for the people of Northern Ohio because they deserve nothing less. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = = = = = = Thank you, Marcy Kaptur | | Congresswoman Marcy Kaptur is a champion for the Midwest in Congress. subject: How is it any different?
body:
[](https://grotg-glenngrothmanforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ahhujo-jyltijykjd-r/) Do you lock your doors at night, friend?There's a reason we turn our deadbolts before we go to bed -- to keep our family safe from unwanted visitors.**How is our southern border any different?** You wouldn't sleep with your doors open, so why do we leave our southern border wide open?We need to Take Back the House to secure our southern border, but I need your help to do that.[**_Will you rush a donation of just $15 so we can secure our southern border NOW?_**](https://grotg-glenngrothmanforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ahhujo-jyltijykjd-y/) [>> Contribute $15 to Secure Southern Border <<](https://grotg-glenngrothmanforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ahhujo-jyltijykjd-j/) [>> Contribute $30 to Keep Wisconsin Red! <<](https://grotg-glenngrothmanforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ahhujo-jyltijykjd-t/) [I'll Contribute $100 or More!](https://grotg-glenngrothmanforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-ahhujo-jyltijykjd-i/) **_Joe Biden, Nancy Pelosi, and their cronies have left the door to our southern border wide open, and it is KILLING and HURTING Americans._** Every day it seems like there is a new horror story resulting from Joe Biden's border. Friend,

I am just a kid from Wrightsville, Georgia, who has lived the American Dream.

Growing up, I had a speech impediment. I was embarrassed to speak up in class or to ask my teachers for help, so my grades suffered in elementary school. I lived in fear of what my classmates might do or say to me on the playground.

My parents were extremely hardworking people, but they didn't have a lot of money. They couldn't afford to send me to a private school or hire a specialist to help me improve my speech. All roads in my small town of Wrightsville seemed to indicate that I would struggle for the rest of my time in school. Luckily for me, that was not the end of my story.

_**[Will you help me win back our Republican majority?>>](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c89017%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=asAGlw3jn81eK5g%2bfiQ1UA&sysid=1)**_

I began sitting in front of the mirror every day and reciting difficult words again and again until I got them right. Eventually, my speech began to improve, and I gained the confidence to speak up in class. I also started working out and made both the track and football teams.

After helping my high school football team win a state championship, I continued playing football at the University of Georgia. I helped the Bulldogs win the 1980 national championship, and I capped my college career by winning the 1982 Heisman Trophy. I played 15 years in the USFL and NFL for several incredible teams. I then had the honor of representing the United States in the 1992 Winter Olympics in bobsledding.

_**I am proof the American Dream is alive and well.**_

_**[Help Republicans retake Congress and save the American Dream.>>](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c89018%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=J0PamLTBIw4xBAgqnuRsqQ&sysid=1)**_

Only in the United States, the greatest country in the WORLD, is my story possible. America is a nation built on self-determination, and no matter a person's beginnings, we all have the opportunity to reach the top of our chosen field.

Together, we can take back our Republican majority and save the American Dream for every American, no matter who you are or where you come from. But we need YOU on our team. Will you join me in this fight to preserve the greatest country in the world?

_**[Please contribute $45 to help Republicans take back the House and Senate and save America from Joe Biden's disastrous agenda. >>](http://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c89019%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=jhvhVty4sPBAekg0fNRL9Q&sysid=1)**_

---
Peter,

Despite more than $60 million spent in false attack ads dragging me through the mud, _**a new poll has the Senate race in Georgia TIED.**_

Yes, you read that right. **TIED!**

That's the good news, but here's the bad news...

**[Raphael Warnock has raised more money than anybody in the country, so he can target undecided voters with precision messaging.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61742595:6AyY1NGiN:m:1:3368395361:3B98ED8A3A73DB4B74699A689B1C20A3:r)**

I can win - the latest polling data shows that, **[but I need your financial support immediately to make it happen.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61742595:6AyY1NGiN:m:1:3368395361:3B98ED8A3A73DB4B74699A689B1C20A3:r)**

**This is an urgent plea for your help.** Early voting records are being broken every day. While we have no way to tell how much of the vote is breaking our direction, Democrats typically vote early while more Republicans prefer to vote on Election Day.

body:

This sponsored message from Defend the Constitution is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b691ae5da0bd44969401016c8a7727bb&_e=RDBo2gMwgq0AaTlWK7ILBEPKDbPa-DbX_wsJSdpA5grjpgRjLlR-s_rtG0502Vpf7wtm-qU-E57Hg8laKvCeo-rYc9N_tZWoZmzkbboPVlzca03rX19F3X176Wsql4QreXLmyiQRZl3AjtXk9H7NFC8vO6nXoZoV48USob8MhJR2uZ4-UKFRpBlbjCL-4DWO7Rv-bo-Lu7XVVIOsQ3oPljp-4upWWnYkFRu1dC_XXHk7Ni__OXu3tsuGcxlSK4Mx8qMzt8U-TB8TsxouCeyZC2iDEcRR3Jcsr0u4yJN2VdHIvPcMY-eUX-tagQsy7EdOE5PWb0Vz6YFbft4FOwTVm_8f9bVKUPUJZfhz3TEb_FywgGhclUCQCfH3qrnIGSwKZjJztQhgl_LGuBjwav-OCQ%3D%3D) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we're losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important. To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course entitled "The Second World Wars." Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson, this course explores how the conflict's diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. body:
|
| | | Peter,

I'm former Congresswoman Tulsi Gabbard - please take a moment to read this entire message. It's critical to the future of our country.

Recently, I announced that I am leaving the Democratic Party, and I want to take a moment to tell you why.

I believe in a government of the people, by the people, and for the people. Unfortunately, today's Democratic Party does not. Instead, it stands for a government of, by, and for the powerful elite.

I love our country. Our God-given rights of freedom, life, and liberty enshrined in our Constitution and Bill of Rights are my inspiration. I answered the call to serve and took an oath, dedicating my life to supporting and defending those freedoms, both in uniform and in public office.

**[Now, my mission continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That's why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61742824:6M5qmNGcN:m:1:3317145305:43CE37CB67D73EB59C61C1BF6B016549:r "Now, my mission
continues: working to elect pro-American patriots to the Senate. That’s why I am supporting my good friend Markwayne Mullin. ")**

He just told me he is coming up on his biggest fundraising deadline and is still $4,457 short of his goal. **[Can you chip in $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61742824:6M5qmNGcN:m:1:3317145305:43CE37CB67D73EB59C61C1BF6B016549:r "Can you chip in
$10, $25, $50, or even $100 to help?")**

Your donation will send a strong message to Democratic Party elites that we are tired of their constant attacks on our freedoms.

Let's remember the ideals our founders laid out for us. Draw inspiration from their hopes for this country, and take action to bring about a government that is truly of, by, and for the people.

If you can't stomach the direction that so-called woke Democratic Party ideologues are taking our country, I invite you to join me.

**[A donation of $10, $25, $50, or even $100 to my friend Markwayne Mullin will help ensure we stand up to woke Democratic Party leaders.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61742824:6M5qmNGcN:m:1:3317145305:43CE37CB67D73EB59C61C1BF6B016549:r "A donation of

Tulsi Gabbard

body:
Will you help me continue my story?

| |
---
| | | Friend, my name is Adam Laxalt. You may have never heard of me, so I wanted to take a moment to tell you a bit about why I'm running for U.S. Senate in Nevada.

I was born in Reno, Nevada and raised by a single mother. Growing up, it was just me and my mom. I have always aspired to be as much of a leader as she was.

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f5ff5ff26f714cefaa84f75424b141d2&_e=vQEufiH8IzA_y-d8sdcckKriwuf6mwSENik2soZvjAgjAUYcKvOa0B08hfWWUFXShZSGUumnEj9XHlut1t3eXOa8w2kQ-gC5pydTF8tz7TWR5395Bcz2Tj_r7AjlEURRE_H8Mb1-9YBNi6lCzaYHfLjwnudsyR_j-KYSNAep8G5AoEnN-QCTF08RF8wN_DydKHZIj_Py6wH66E5NpZJMmbQzmHirQ-tiCEpF0Z56E6KTK2m4k7l4vhKlWnTbNJVTnIN4hx_Luzeud0NJp0PhqLW2vxmulsJCmjRKN_C8OvjTmeExbXreoNlcaacEdeBhFzR9-mqszC7cJVPXdSW3ngNHXL8aaQfRht0UFKa8CozPAnA-adbUYEqA13ksmLn69UeV_3AWwGPQbqQGP21vKguBdzjVIZhQ94E3ryhqIKLplc9WDNpvaVxvm7ce1OJu "Adam 1")
---

I know that real leadership means standing up for what you believe in and standing up for people everywhere. But I was headed down the wrong path in life.

As a teenager, I suffered from addiction. But the people who loved me got me help. I turned my life around, and that taught me helping others gives life meaning. That's why I volunteered to serve in the Navy after 9/11 and volunteered to serve in the Iraq War.

---
| | | [SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f5ff5ff26f714cefaa84f75424b141d2&_e=vQEufiH8IzA_y-d8sdcckKriwuf6mwSENik2soZvjAgjAUYcKvOa0B08hfWWUFXShZSGUumnEj9XHlut1t3eXOa8w2kQ-gC5pydTF8tz7TWR5395Bcz2Tj_r7AjlEURRE_H8Mb1-9YBNi6lCzaYHfLjwnudsyR_j-KYSNAep8G5AoEnN-QCTF08RF8wN_DydKHZIj_Py6wH66E5NpZJMmbQzmHirQ-tiCEpF0Z56E6KTK2m4k7l4vhKlWnTbNJVTnIN4hx_Luzeud0NJp0PhqC_Q4VVXthNHrktgMRLRqiKCxkFQcfOVT7tP40nllW0L_V3XC4Hufri2JhodIRqUoIllDY-bkDFB996wCrMsO1tR2IIIqSyAWaKFO8yipPX8elbLSIoLCqqAIjKb7oNo960O1aPHo0U9-wpDy_cw9Z5D1XQAPh6zqJfanz_MUmmW "SUPPORT ADAM LAXALT")
---

Serving our country as a Navy Officer in Iraq was an honor.

While I was serving, my unit was in charge of over 20,000 detainees to keep American troops safe. This was one of the most challenging experiences of my life, but also the most rewarding.

_Knowing that I was on the front lines of protecting the country I love so dearly is something that I will continue to cherish for the rest of my life. _

---
| [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f5ff5ff26f714cefaa84f75424b141d2&_e=vQEufiH8IzA_y-d8sdcckKriwuf6mwSENik2soZvjAgjAUYcKvOa0B08hfWWUFXShZSGUumnEj9XHlut1t3eXOa8w2kQ-gC5pydTF8tz7TWR5395Bcz2Tj_r7AjlEURRE_H8Mb1-9YBNi6lCzaYHfLjwnudsyR_j-KYSNAep8G5AoEnN-QCTF08RF8wN_DydKHZIj_Py6wH66E5NpZJMmbQzmHirQ-tiCEpF0Z56E6KTK2m4k7l4vhKlWnTbNJVTnIN4hx_Luzeud0NJp0PhqCKeUzOBkECb9IHiPxCePOegp_20ANgUep0S1mOdSv6k5QneyEbef_lzyDiu3ZUTIqYA7t9tLTdJAXz8q65FDwotGqpbojbQ0w_lwiNl6YBqF8tyHPRxa6N5OaheUVOU0C5GXPB9oMYX_BR_3T5le8LJJ34a4_49W-G37Cb00owG "Adam 2")
---

After returning from Iraq, I felt the call to serve my state again and went on to be Nevada's Attorney General and top law enforcement officer. I fought hard to serve the people of Nevada, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

Now I'm taking on a huge challenge for our country: running for U.S. Senate.

---

My race is **officially the #1 race in the country** , and all eyes are on me. The Democrats have already raised 76 MILLION to destroy my campaign.

Unlike my opponent, I rely on grassroots supporters like you to keep my campaign running.

Team —
I’ve served my country in the Navy, at NASA, and now in the Senate.
No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions.
And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble.
National Republicans are attacking the right to abortion, denying the devastating impact climate change is having on our planet, and spreading misinformation about the integrity of our elections nationwide. But I refuse to let them win.
I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. I think our leaders should follow the facts, listen to the science, and act decisively — will you split a donation between my campaign and Seth Moulton if you agree? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-kelly?refcode=221027_MK_split]
I didn’t serve 25 years in the Navy just for Republicans to threaten our country from within by sowing doubt and misinformation about the integrity of our elections. Our leaders should respect the will of the voters and free and fair elections — if you agree, will you split a donation between my campaign and Seth Moulton? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-kelly?refcode=221027_MK_split]
Science, data, and facts have helped me solve some of the most difficult challenges in my life. And I think we need more members of Congress who are willing to put politics aside and do the same.
I can’t overstate how important this upcoming election is. Chip in $20 or more today, split between my campaign and Seth Moulton, if you’re ready to help me win re-election and defend our majority >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/moulton-kelly?refcode=221027_MK_split]
I’ll never back down from doing what’s right.
Thank you for staying in the fight with me,
Mark

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: This is my story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743405:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743405:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743405:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743405:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743405:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743405:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743405:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "I will always stand up for our heroes
and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743405:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743405:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find
solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743405:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743405:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743405:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743406:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Peter, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743406:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743406:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743407:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743408:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743408:JwhgYNGNE:m:1:3253819041:4365342FAFCB8604A5D2DB12FA2A2F64:r "Step up now!")**_

---

---

Peter, Secretary Hillary Clinton said it best: We _need_ Letitia James fighting as our attorney general.

From the moment she made history by becoming the first Black woman ever to serve as New York’s attorney general, Letitia has been an _unstoppable_ force of nature.

As Tampa’s murder rate and violent crime rate continues to skyrocket, not a single sheriff, law enforcement agency or organization has endorsed Castor | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/a145ad4b00a8/running-for-congress-in-my-hometown-13690560?e=00028e5542)
---
[**Days after latest Tampa murder, Florida Law Enforcement Representatives Endorse James Judge for Florida’s 14th Congressional District**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=9ebbeb8228&e=00028e5542) _As Tampa’s murder rate and violent crime rate continues to skyrocket, not a single sheriff, law enforcement agency or organization has endorsed Castor’s campaign, while Judge has received numerous endorsements by those in local and state law enforcement._
TAMPA, Fla. – The organization that represents more than 26,000 Florida law enforcement officers has decided to endorse James Judge for the U.S. House of Representatives in Florida’s 14th Congressional District, the Judge campaign announced Thursday.On Wednesday evening, the Florida Police Benevolent Association, “the Voice of Florida’s Law Enforcement Officers,” notified Judge of their endorsement.“The Florida Police Benevolent Association, Inc. is proud to inform you of our endorsement of your candidacy for United States Representative, District 14. We will ask our members, their friends and families, and all citizens in the district who respect the strong and efficient enforcement of our laws, to cast their ballots in support of James Judge,” said the letter sent by the Florida PBA.The endorsement is another in a string of endorsements by law enforcement officials and organizations, which include the Tampa Police Benevolent Association, Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri, and retired Pinellas County Sheriff Jim Coats.It also comes just days after Judge was participating in another ride-along with Tampa Police Department officers. Halfway through the patrol, a 20-year-old man was shot and killed just one block away from Judge and Tampa Police Officers in Ybor City on Sunday morning.“The violent crime rate, which has skyrocketed over the past few years, is a direct reflection of the weak-on-crime policies of the Castor Regime, both Kathy and Jane Castor, and showcases a failure of their leadership as our community grows less safe. It’s no surprise that Castor has not received a single endorsement from law enforcement officials,” Judge said. “I am honored to receive statewide support from law enforcement officers, and when I am elected to Congress, I will do everything in my power to make sure our men and women in law enforcement have the tools and support they need to make our communities safe again.”The Florida Police Benevolent Association is one of the largest organizations to represent Florida law enforcement officers with more than 26,000 members, and is open to all certified law enforcement and corrections officers in the state.On Aug. 23, Judge won his primary election by 24 points, despite being outspent 10-to-one by his closest competitor.In addition to the endorsement by the Florida PBA, Judge has earned the endorsement of several prominent figures and organizations.They include:· Congressman Brian Mast (R-FL)· Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ)· Congressman Ted Yoho (R-FL) retired· Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard· Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri· The Tampa Police Benevolent Association· Pinellas County Sheriff Jim Coats (retired)· Associated Builders and Contractors Florida Gulf Coast· The Community Patriots Tampa· Republican strategist Roger Stone· Chris Chambers, former Congressional candidate and community leader· Matt Becker, small business owner, former SBA White House Deputy Chief, and former Congressional Candidate**About James Judge:
** Judge, a Tampa Bay area native, is the Republican nominee for Florida’s 14th Congressional District. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and was deployed to Iraq in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom while serving in the U.S. Coast Guard. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011 under General David Petraeus. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the National Rifle Association, Veterans of Foreign Wars, the American Legion, the Tampa Propeller Club and the Coastal Conservation Association. The Judges are also long-time, active members of Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

Let me explain why it’s so important to donate today.
**This race is very close and could likely come down to a few hundred votes separating me and the Republican candidate. So it’s crunch time to make sure Oregon voters know the truth about my opponents.**
When we were colleagues in the Oregon House, Republican Christine Drazan led a walk out that killed efforts to build homeless shelters and affordable housing. A swing and a miss for TV Doctor Mehmet Oz | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wqcJuDX2HRji8zceUQ74uMPyXwArFUhhEylhu27HuuFZPbUWWTdGH4838vBzdyazPkgGfSEI9dOrau8XGHCENJ6Je06YUb2AtP8-YN1Byq9GBTg8785gsbQ_ffAWduYcpVWnWtqn_7caPs7k3baZR6iXO_hTQkwfoWzQFPNlT6LG4_BVDJGhvkMZue0JyTmnwOwajMNhnaT7gFVrl6B_n5IfB1uhcbt6h_NpoIHU8mqOBGGZgbH_lzn8YjABG0nmZRxAXUe4EV6rg8jJ1HihEF_lsbAwkPTfWvvV4F_96oaEg87bYn8FTFCUX7Pa-XxhJXmnUjAYgYVBQgn5Bab5_yY_35x9s3F6xhGixT8Or-lj7tY1VM6rnWq7ofhXhg1Zs4Zq_zkomF2zi8IE4gA2nS/3qn/Ym2n28_LSBu4HAjSPhEawQ/h0/3Qb1D4IqqNAijYGq8k0DyrXAPxqupNAF1KJWn-CTR7Q)
Last night in Pennsylvania, Democratic Senate candidate John Fetterman faced off with Donald Trump’s favored purveyor of diet pills Dr. Oz in their first and only debate. While the corporate media was predictably focused on Fetterman’s progress recovering from a stroke, it was Oz’s comments on abortion that are most newsworthy. PeterHi, it’s Tulsi Gabbard, former Democratic Congresswoman and former Vice Chair of the Democratic National Committee.I recently left the Democratic Party because it’s under the complete control of an elitist cabal of warmongers driven by cowardly “wokeness.”
[](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=ddde1784eb&e=fdefed58de)
Democrats have gone insane with ideological fanaticism, and to put it plainly, the Democratic Party that I joined doesn’t exist anymore.[**Today, I’m proud to endorse John Gibbs for Congress in Michigan’s 3rd District.**](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=830b056ce7&e=fdefed58de) John is a leader who puts people first, is fighting for border security, energy independence, public safety, and other policies that actually make life better for the American people.
My parents were married in East Grand Rapids, which is my mother’s hometown. This district and John’s race matter to me. [**So I hope you’ll join me today in supporting John’s campaign with a generous gift.**](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=6db8c4f080&e=fdefed58de)
John isn’t afraid to call out permanent Washington and the propagandists in the mainstream media who aim to keep them in power.Our country is in desperate need of leaders like John who will stand up for the objective truth and bring the fight directly to the dogmatic fanaticism of ideologues leading the Democratic Party.[**Please join me in supporting John’s campaign here.**](https://unitedamericanconservatives.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=22432bec7f541233c6007cfc2&id=31de0c1cc2&e=fdefed58de)
With aloha,Tulsi Gabbard

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

| | | _Our friends at[Indivisible](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf9adf0a2-d364-4d10-8fff-6415ac464779/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) are doing amazing work to keep MAGA Republicans from stealing our democracy. **[_Add your name to join the fight_! >>](https://default.salsalabs.org/Te0356467-78e3-49cc-a82c-2912312b185e/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**_
---
| | | Friend, We’re coming down to the final days and weeks of this year’s election season, and here at Indivisible, **[we’re using what little time we have left to hold (and hopefully expand) our Democratic majority in Congress.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T7df063eb-cd41-4962-974c-ea237d19d754/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** This year’s midterms could come down to a handful of votes, literally. Remember when President Biden won Georgia and Arizona by about 1/4 of 1 percent in 2020? **These are the types of races we’re looking at now, folks — races where even a tiny investment could make the difference.** We’re in this fight together — and together is how we’re going to win. This broad, pro-democracy supermajority is pulling together to defeat the radical MAGA zealots seeking to roll back our access to abortion, attack our most vulnerable communities, and tear down our democracy. And if we all do our part, we’re going to win this thing. **[That’s why we’re reaching out, to ask if you’ll join the fight with us. Add your name if you agree it’s important we do absolutely everything we can right now to protect our Democratic majority and prevent MAGA Republicans from taking over our democracy.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T98f8737e-4a92-4d75-848e-6dc974adaea2/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**
