| | | Here’s how high the stakes are this November, friends: _FiveThirtyEight_ says that 60 percent of Americans will have an election denier on the ballot. 60 percent! These candidates are legitimate threats to our democracy, but we know how to stop them. Indivisible groups across the country are putting in the work to highlight MAGA Republicans’ extremism and shift the narrative of this election. Recent polls show our strategy is working – but as races are tightening across the country, we simply cannot take any chances. With just days until November 8, we’re looking to pour every resource we can into this fight. If — no, when — we win, we get a real and functioning democracy, and we make Mitch McConnell, Joe Manchin, and Kyrsten Sinema politically irrelevant. But we won’t have the votes tomorrow unless we do the work today. Our democracy’s on the ballot this November, and it’s on us to protect it. [**If you’re with us, add your name right away.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc3325bb7-2559-4663-94cd-f2b8d22b774f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you for being a part of this movement. In solidarity, Indivisible Team

body:
The final stretch is here
Hi team,
I can’t believe we’re in the final stretch of this campaign. I just wanted to take a few minutes to say thank you. Seriously, this campaign has been successful because of people like you.
It’s taken a lot to get to where we are today. Sacrifices from my family, countless hours talking with voters and community leaders, and years of gaining experience – from working on the Hill to serving in the Pentagon under Obama.
**One thing hasn’t changed for me, and that’s how important I know this race is.** It’s the reason why I started this campaign so many months ago. I know we keep hammering this point home, but this race really is one of the ten most competitive in the country.
**All eyes are on Pinellas County to make the right choice – a choice that protects our democracy, our rights, and our future, instead of one that succumbs to hate and fear mongering.**
We have the strategy to win. We have the right people on our team. We have endorsements from dozens of bipartisan organizations, community leaders, and representatives. Now, it’s all up to reaching the most voters.
**That’s where I need your help, team. My team is telling me that we need to reach 10,000 more voters before Election Day to make a difference in this race.** Right now, I’m tied in the polls, and we can’t go into Election Day with numbers within the margin of error. We can’t afford to lose.
**Will you chip in $15 or whatever you are able to make sure that we can hold onto this seat and protect the Democratic majority in Congress? Dear , Did you know that in Connecticut, nearly 40 percent of ballots that soldiers said they submitted never arrived?(CT Post, April 13, 2013).Connecticut has over 4,200 active-duty military personnel serving in the armed forces. Our service men and women vote absentee from all over the world using a universal OCOVO application for absentee ballots or by downloading a PDF from the Secretary of the State website. It is estimated that an overseas military voter and eligible dependent need 45 days to cast their vote in time for an election.In 2020 an estimated 42% voted in the Connecticut presidential election which is below the average of 47% of the military voting in 2020. Over 54% of all military voters report difficulties voting because of the lengthy mail times or because of difficulty accessing their state’s websites. In all, 88% have access to the internet, and only 70% have access to a printer. My vision is a multipart program to reduce mail/transit time and eventually eliminate all mail with a fully secure digital program for voting whereby military voting timelines are measured in days and not weeks.To read my full plan, [click here](https://dominicforct.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ebcefd906ec01db66e79c886c&id=5963e0ff00&e=8763c56857). Thank you and Godspeed,
Dominic RapiniRepublican Candidate for Secretary of the State

From day one, we knew that organizing was the way to build the movement and momentum it would take to flip this seat – and also to have the kind of conversations and build the kind of connections that we need in our country right now.
And it’s working – together and because of your support, we have built the largest organizing program WNC has ever seen. The energy is palpable and you can feel it growing each day as more people join us. This is a big part of what is making me so hopeful right now.
NC-11 is a battleground district – and in tight races, having face-to-face conversations about how we’re going to pave a new path forward is indispensable to winning.

name: Doug Stuart
subject: Woke activists are pushing religious mockery
body:
[](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743993:Je0ToNGNg:m:1:3365131770:D1144773A862BB72DDBDDD2540941C9D:r)
Peter,

Woke activists are pushing Critical Race Theory (CRT) to take over our institutions and corrupt our society.

And let's be honest, even non-Christians identify this woke movement as a secular religion based on neo-Marxism. It's a catharsis for non-religious people to act out religion, and they are making a mockery of faith.
* George Floyd murals resemble religious iconography.
* When University College London stopped paying Stonewall, an LGBTQ+ charity, protesters held signs with messages like _" Rejoin Stonewall Or Go To Hell."_
* The movement pushes an identity of victimhood, not an identity in Christ.

**These woke social justice warriors are fanatics who use manipulative tactics designed to undermine the free society that built our nation.**

Conservatives and libertarians need Christianity to build an honest society.

My name is Doug Stuart, CEO of the Libertarian Christian Institute (LCI). The LCI was created to make the _Christian_ case for free markets and free people. I've set a goal to connect with 500 new supporters this week to share the Christian case for libertarianism with America.

[_**If you believe Christians need to fight for liberty, spread the Gospel, and defeat Big Government, can you chip in $5, $10, $35, or any amount? Click here to donate >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743993:Je0ToNGNg:m:1:3365131770:D1144773A862BB72DDBDDD2540941C9D:r)

Woke activists are hell-bent on saving the world through aggression.

They claim that all their efforts are simply to help everyone from harming themselves. But they seek to use the state to impose their worldview far more than most religious believers.

_And with no religious humility to reign them in, they do far more harm_.

But, in the words of Benjamin Franklin, _" Rebellion to Tyrants is Obedience to God."_

More importantly, we should heed the words of Acts 5:29, _**" We ought to obey God rather than men."**_

Christians are integral to defending liberty, preserving morality in our culture, and opposing the evils of empires.

[_**You can help LCI promote libertarianism from a Christian point of view. Click here to donate >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61743993:Je0ToNGNg:m:1:3365131770:D1144773A862BB72DDBDDD2540941C9D:r)

The Libertarian Christian Institute envisions a world where Christians promote the values and principles of a free society as the most consistent expression of Christian political thought.

We see a world where Christians demonstrate that individual liberty is a force for the common good.

**We aim to persuade Christians that the political expression of our faith inclines us toward the principles of individual liberty and free markets.**

Peter, LCI can't do this alone. We need Christians to band together now and show the world what true faith and religion look like, not this woke mockery.

Can I count on you to join us with a gift of $10 or any amount? **Click below to donate.**

You and I cannot surrender our country to woke, socialist activists and Big Government agents.

God has tasked us with fighting for liberty and justice while on Earth. This is a responsibility we have as mankind.

Doug Stuart

To identify your closest Center, please check the Board of Elections website at [www.elections.maryland.gov/elections](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53435435/375429556/-2065343216?refcode=em221026ev&refcode2=523031e5-0056-ed11-819c-002248258e08&contactdata=ZesJV5D4BKDJLTFmqwuXRixoKyzoaCLU7P/UQG+S1SCJfnizrBAl9I5k00RlL6IN&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjMwMzFlNS0wMDU2LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=39oXkNxPamX1MwF22hTp-4FY38p3JeByoT_xIs0B-tc=&emci=2a6be7f0-7f55-ed11-819c-002248258e08&emdi=523031e5-0056-ed11-819c-002248258e08&ceid=2216363). Making a plan to vote early is the surest way to ensure that nothing unexpected interferes with your ability to vote in this important election!
As many of you may be aware, over the last two weeks GOP SuperPACs have poured shockingly high last-minute resources into many critical Senate races across the country — both open seats in places like Ohio and Pennsylvania, and contests where Democratic incumbents are seeking re-election like Arizona, Georgia, Nevada and even Washington state where long-serving Senator Patty Murray is up for re-election.
When the polls close and the results come in, I am hoping that we will all be able to see that Republicans wasted their money spreading lies and fueling hate and division. But the truth is: we can't count on that. We must do whatever we can in these final two weeks to push folks to get out and vote for elected officials that will put 'people' over big-money special interests and fight for an agenda that reflects our values and priorities.
[**Even as I cross our state to meet with voters and get out the vote here in Maryland, we continue to work to help Democratic colleagues and candidates in tough races across the country. You can click here to pitch in whatever you are able to support our efforts to keep the Senate Majority and protect our forward-looking agenda from the return of a GOP-controlled Senate with Mitch McConnell as Majority Leader and people like Ted Cruz running Senate Committees.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53435438/375429559/-493388986?refcode=&refcode2=523031e5-0056-ed11-819c-002248258e08&contactdata=ZesJV5D4BKDJLTFmqwuXRixoKyzoaCLU7P/UQG+S1SCJfnizrBAl9I5k00RlL6IN&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODIzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1MjMwMzFlNS0wMDU2LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=39oXkNxPamX1MwF22hTp-4FY38p3JeByoT_xIs0B-tc=)
A return to Mitch McConnell's rule in the United States Senate would be a very bitter pill for our country — to say the least. It would set back every single critical issue on our agenda and lay the ground for two years of attacks on Democrats and the Biden White House leading up to the 2024 Presidential election.
We must do everything in our power to make sure Mitch McConnell doesn’t get the gavel back!
Thank you, as always, for being an informed and engaged voter — and for reaching out to speak to friends, neighbors, and others who may have questions about the stakes in the election.
Before I sign off, I would also like to ask for your vote to continue fighting for you in the United States Senate.
I hope you will vote early and encourage others to do the same.
Onwards!
Chris

clean_body: = Early Voting begins today across Maryland and in many other parts of the country. Early Voting Centers will be open through next Thursday, November 3. To identify your closest Center, please check the Board of Elections website at . Making a plan to vote early is the surest way to ensure that nothing unexpected interferes with your ability to vote in this important election! As many of you may be aware, over the last two weeks GOP SuperPACs have poured shockingly high last-minute resources into many critical Senate races across the country — both open seats in places like Ohio and Pennsylvania, and contests where Democratic incumbents are seeking re-election like Arizona, Georgia, Nevada and even Washington state where long-serving Senator Patty Murray is up for re-election. When the polls close and the results come in, I am hoping that we will all be able to see that Republicans wasted their money spreading lies and fueling hate and division. But the truth is: we can't count on that. We must do whatever we can in these final two weeks to push folks to get out and vote for elected officials that will put 'people' over big-money special interests and fight for an agenda that reflects our values and priorities. = A return to Mitch McConnell's rule in the United States Senate would be a very bitter pill for our country — to say the least. It would set back every single critical issue on our agenda and lay the ground for two years of attacks on Democrats and the Biden White House leading up to the 2024 Presidential election. We must do everything in our power to make sure Mitch McConnell doesn’t get the gavel back! Thank you, as always, for being an informed and engaged voter — and for reaching out to speak to friends, neighbors, and others who may have questions about the stakes in the election. Before I sign off, I would also like to ask for your vote to continue fighting for you in the United States Senate. I hope you will vote early and encourage others to do the same. Onwards! Chris Our campaign relies on contributions from grassroots supporters like you to re-elect Chris to the U.S. Senate and continue his work to protect our democracy and expand our Senate majority. **=** Van Hollen for Senate 10605 Concord St. Ste 202 Kensington, MD 20895 PAID FOR BY VAN HOLLEN FOR SENATE If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, you can , but we'd be very sorry to see you go.

#

Friends -
Here’s a quick story that will hopefully inspire you to help us in our shared struggle to make our communities safer from gun violence.
*** Content warning — Graphic descriptions ***
One of the unfathomably sad and grisly facts about school shootings where an assault weapon is used is that the damage the firearm causes can make a young body unrecognizable.
In Texas, instead of acting to limit the use of assault weapons, they passed a law sending DNA kits home with children to help identify them “in case of an emergency.”
Imagine having the power to act to make our children safer from gun violence in their schools, and instead using that power to make it easier to identify their bodies “in case of an emergency.”
It’s a stark illustration of the choice voters have in this election, and why we are fighting every day to make sure we elect candidates and officials who will choose to act to make our communities safer.

He fights for you the same way he fights for his family because he believes we all have the right to raise our families, make a living, and worship our God without Big Government intervention.

Unlike the far-Left, Governor DeSantis doesn’t have the desire to control every aspect of your lives, he just has the goal to leave this state better than he found it. We think so far, he's done a pretty great job – but we’ve only begun to fight.

We cannot stress the importance of this race enough – this Election Day, Floridians will decide the future of Florida.

Patriot Zach Rehl received an honorable discharge from the United States Marine Corps...and received a 100% disability rating from the Department of Veterans Affairs.

**But the FBI raided his home on March 17th, 2021, arrested him, and threw him in jail for peacefully protesting the stolen 2020 Presidential election at the Capitol on January 6th, 2021.

**He simply exercised his right to free speech as an American citizen.

Zach has been held without bail this entire time.

** “They are jailing innocent people on bogus and trumped-up charges because those people simply supported the sitting president Donald Trump at the time; which is absolutely insane. If you think it can’t happen to you, look at me, because if it can happen to me, trust me, it can happen to you.”
**
That’s why I ask to stand with me at this crucial time.

**I’m Larry Klayman, the founder of Judicial Watch and founder and General Counsel of Freedom Watch.
**
I’m a former federal prosecutor and trial lawyer who’s fought for the American people for 45 years.

You’ve seen me on cable news outlets and heard me on radio talk shows.

**I’m proud to say I am the first lawyer to EVER obtain a court ruling that an American president committed a crime when I won my case against Bill Clinton.
**
I worked closely with Congressman Bob Barr and other impeachment managers to IMPEACH criminal Bill Clinton.

And I SUCCESSFULLY represented the victims of other Clinton scandals, like Filegate, Travelgate, IRS Gate, Chinagate, and many others.

Not to mention that I also enjoined Obama’s corrupt NSA from mass surveillance on hundreds of millions of Americans and killed Obama’s illegal amnesty for over 5 million illegal aliens, a case that went all the way to the Supreme Court!

**I know what it takes to take on federal agencies, politicians, even presidents – AND WIN!
**
And now I’m pursuing two class action lawsuits and other important legal actions to get justice for the January 6 Protesters and take on Joe Biden’s rotten regime in court.

**Nobody else is doing what I’m doing in court to get justice for these poor people.
**
[Patriot, PLEASE help me double down in my fight to GET JUSTICE FOR ALL JANUARY 6 PROTESTERS AND SET THEM FREE with your absolutely vital gift of $25, $50, $100 or even more RIGHT NOW.
](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zndups5fbkcbdnhbk0nvjkgvkv54ng30o8doghng_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3iecor2clh2bs)
I’m using two powerful lawsuits and other hard-hitting legal actions to do this.

You and I can save our country if we act peacefully and legally NOW.

Sincerely,

Larry Klayman
Founder of both Judicial Watch and Freedom Watch
Current Chairman and General Counsel of Freedom Watch, Inc.

P.S. Patriot, Zach Rehl is one of many good Americans enduring abuse and heartbreaking suffering right now just because they spoke out peacefully on January 6th.

We no longer live in a democracy, but instead a Biden “Gestapo Police State!” This CANNOT and WILL NOT stand! The Republicans are doing NOTHING about this, BUT WE WILL!

[Please help me fight for these peaceful January 6 protesters in court with your best gift of $25, $50, $100, or more right away.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zm2lro9e9i2093bfcjcb4ikambimg7f92bnvjl00_rp22sh2s8i66or3c3iecor2clh2bs)

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Larry Klayman

Peter,

This is the most personal and vulnerable email I have ever sent you... But I must share my story and tell you why I created the BLEXIT Foundation.

Before I share my story, allow me to introduce the BLEXIT Foundation.

**For too long, I have watched Black Americans force-fed a message of victimhood, fear, defeat, and dependence. And, this has to stop.** In 2019, with Brandon Tatum, we created BLEXIT Foundation - a nonprofit organization - dedicated to bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Our message to America's black and minority communities is that you are not a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family, and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture.

This is WRONG.

I've dealt with racism... _**I 've even received death threats**_. Racism is an ugly form of collectivism and is unacceptable.

[_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61744105:JjZ9VNGNV:m:1:3368395361:8DE4EFC2DD760F4BC6317F54E359CD5C:r)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61744105:JjZ9VNGNV:m:1:3368395361:8DE4EFC2DD760F4BC6317F54E359CD5C:r)

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. Hello,
**The attacks from Chuck Grassley keep coming.**
_“The most liberal nominee in Iowa Senate history”
“Radical”
“Socialist”_
Gotta love it!
Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks.
Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check. **But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley’s attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy.**
Grassley is trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore.
Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy.
**Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child.**
**And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional.**
These are the kinds of attacks I’m up against. Nasty stuff from Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and the Fox ‘Entertainment’ News propaganda network.
There’s one reason why: The GOP is scared. They’ve seen the polls, and they know that if we defeat Grassley and turn Iowa blue this November, Democrats are guaranteed to maintain our Senate majority.
**In order to fight back, a group of donors is QUADRUPLE MATCHING ALL GIFTS for the first time ever. clean_body: Less than an hour after I was declared the Democratic nominee for Senate in Iowa, the attacks from Chuck Grassley began. If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please. Hello, The attacks from Chuck Grassley keep coming. “The most liberal nominee in Iowa Senate history” “Radical” “Socialist” Gotta love it! Chuck Grassley doesn’t know what to say about me. He’s never faced an opponent like me before. I’m his political nightmare, so he’s just throwing cow pies at the wall and hoping something sticks. Calling me “radical” is laughable when Chuck Grassley supports a complete ban on abortion and letting literally anyone buy an AR-15 without even a background check. But there’s one attack that I absolutely won’t take lying down, and that’s Chuck Grassley’s attacking me for serving our country for 36 years in the U.S. Navy. Grassley is trying to say that because I enlisted in the military at age 19, because my deployments meant that my family had to move from state-to-state and country-to-country... that I’m not an Iowan anymore. Chuck Grassley wants to pretend that I wasn’t raised in rural, northwest Iowa. He ignores the enormous sacrifices that my family – my wife and my kids – made to allow me to serve in the Navy. Grassley’s attacks denigrate every servicemember and every military family that has to pack up, change schools, say goodbye to friends, spend holidays away from each other, and be absent from life’s big events like weddings and the birth of a child. And if Chuck Grassley thinks that I will stand silent while he says that every Iowan who puts on our country’s uniform stops being an Iowan... he’s delusional. These are the kinds of attacks I’m up against. Nasty stuff from Chuck Grassley, Mitch McConnell, and the Fox ‘Entertainment’ News propaganda network. There’s one reason why: The GOP is scared. Peter,

I wouldn't be reaching out to you so **frantically** _if this wasn 't a dire situation..._ but my Democrat-endorsed opponent is **outraising my campaign** and we're less than two weeks away from Election Day.

[**This critical Senate race could be over unless I hear from you and 15 more conservatives from your area in the next 15 minutes.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61745197:JvN8INGbN:m:1:3331703221:118F5793D904DBCB38D7F9114B66ED29:r)

Now is not the time to fall behind - **too much is at stake in this election for us to lose.** I called my team and asked them what I can do to pick up the pace. Their response? **REACH OUT TO YOU, Peter.**

[**Please, answer my call today and rush in your support.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61745197:JvN8INGbN:m:1:3331703221:118F5793D904DBCB38D7F9114B66ED29:r) If I win - Republicans will win back the Senate majority. **If I lose** - well, you know. We can't let that happen.

The Democrats are determined to win in Utah. Chuck Schumer knows a WIN here is the ONLY WAY the left can hold their majority.

**My campaign is being outraised** and time is running out before Election Day. This is the time when critical ad placements are made and without money in the bank - my opponent will be able to reach more voters at a crucial stage in this race.

[**Please, Peter, I need to hear from you and 15 other conservatives from your area in the next 15 minutes or this race could over.**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61745197:JvN8INGbN:m:1:3331703221:118F5793D904DBCB38D7F9114B66ED29:r)

Help me win and help Republicans take back the Senate majority. **I 'm counting on hearing from you.**

For America,
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61745198:JvN8INGbN:m:1:3331703221:118F5793D904DBCB38D7F9114B66ED29:r)
Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike's father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father's arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman's General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Election Integrity is our priority

There is only 13 days until Election Day and we thought it would be a great time to highlight all the hard work our Election Integrity (EI) team has done this cycle. Election Integrity is a high priority for us because we want to make sure every legal vote is counted. over the summer our EI team has traveled across the commonwealth and recruited volunteers to be our eyes and ears on election day. To date our EI staff has:
* Recruited 3,446 Election Day Poll watcher
* Coordinated with 26,799 volunteers
* Recruited 665 election Day Poll workers
* Held over 500 in-person and virtual training sessions across the Commonwealth

body:
To win in Virginia, Democrats are going to need grassroots support.

|
---
Derek, Virginia is a purple state. Here in the Commonwealth, we can’t always expect Democrats to win without putting in the work it takes to win a tough race. 1 **Republican** Governor
2 **Democratic** Senators

_But we can’t slow down._
Today is a new day and we need to keep giving this goal everything we’ve got. **I know $65,000 seems ambitious but we can’t forget how competitive and expensive this race has been so far.**
Poll after poll has shown Susie and her far-right opponent, April Becker, in a dead heat. And the GOP is doing everything they can to flip this seat – they’ve even spent $14 million against our campaign.
Every dollar we raise goes to funding our campaign on the ground so we can fight back against April Becker’s war chest. Whether it’s knocking doors, making phone calls, running digital ads, or keeping our television ads on the air, **your contribution has helped us keep the momentum in this race.**
Reaching this end-of-month goal is critical to ensuring that Susie keeps this seat blue in a week and some change. body:
We need to rally behind the DNC to ensure Democrats up and down the ballot have the support they need in the midterms in just 12 days. | |
---
I’ve been working to protect and expand our Democratic majorities for most of my career, and I can confidently tell you that next month’s midterm elections will be extremely consequential. In the land of Oz, apparently the decision to get an abortion should be between "a woman, her doctor, and local political leaders."

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_nSVAUZUMGA&t=56s [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_nSVAUZUMGA&t=56s]

Let us repeat that: "a woman, her doctor, and local political leaders."

Let them know they don't get to decide the future of our bodies and they don't get to make medical decisions for us. We CANNOT stay home this election cycle with so much on the line at the ballot box. That's why Keystone Progress is mobilizing the progressive vote in areas of our state that are so often overlooked.

Please help us Get Out The Vote on Nov. 8 by donating today! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/keystone-progress-now?refcode=102722kp2]

Thank you for showing up and protecting our rights!

subject: URGENT - ALLAN FUNG NEEDS HELP ASAP
body:
Good Afternoon!

I'm the Field Director for Allan Fung's campaign. I'm reaching out because we desperately need your help here in the homestretch...

If you didn't see in the news yesterday, [a new poll was released showing that the race between Mayor Fung and Seth Magaziner is tied, with 4% of voters undecided](https://www.providencejournal.com/story/news/politics/2022/10/26/ri-congressional-race-poll-fung-magaziner-have-equal-support-rhode-island/69593173007/). (See here: <https://www.wpri.com/news/elections/democrats-say-party-poll-found-magaziner-gaining-but-gop-argues-fung-is-still-ahead/>).

We are in a dead heat. The Democrats have funneled money and manpower into this district to sway that final 4% their way. **_We need to fight back!!_**

_**We need your support, not just at the polls, but over the next two weeks, specifically the next two weekends.**_

Please shoot me an email or text if you can help us _knock doors_ over the next two weeks/weekends. Frankly, this election depends on it. Let's win this.

Tyler Flanigan
Field Director
860-967-9155 (Cell)
[tflaniganri@gmail.com](mailto:tflaniganri@gmail.com)

Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

Peter,

There is a vampire in America. It has roamed the world for over a hundred years, feeding on the living and leaving horror in its wake.

I'm talking about. . . socialism.

Socialism can drain an entire country of its economic prosperity, leaving nothing but a husk of an economy. And it keeps coming back to life, no matter how many times it is buried.

**And now, this decrepit monster has found its way into America 's public schools.**

I've faced this monster before in Lithuania, and I know how to defeat it.

My name is Zilvinas Silenas, and I am President of the Foundation for Economic Education (FEE). FEE is exposing the vampire of socialism to the light of economic education and banishing it from our schools.

[_**Peter, can you help FEE keep this vampire from attacking the next generation of high school students? Please donate to fight back >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61744861:6QAIwNGN5:m:1:3253819041:C2104F8A03A738D538FE6353F3B825D5:r)

Our faculty of acclaimed instructors lead students through compelling lectures, exciting experiments, and engaging discussions on how the core principles of individual liberty and free-market economics apply to their daily lives.

We've already equipped thousands of high school students with the knowledge they need to resist socialism's power.

**Our goal is to educate 50,000 students by the end of this year.**

To help keep this program free of cost for teachers, I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of October -- $1 for every student.

[_**Peter, can you donate $25, $35, or even $50 to support FEE in the Classroom today? Send your urgent gift >>>**_](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61744861:6QAIwNGN5:m:1:3253819041:C2104F8A03A738D538FE6353F3B825D5:r)

millions of Americans. And today, he’s fighting for candidates like Stacey
who want to build on his vision and help create a system where everyone

years ago nationally.

Derek.

We'll be making some big budget decisions tomorrow that could determine the outcome of this race.
| | | Friends -

Mandela Barnes here, sincerely asking if you can please split a $5 contribution between my campaign and the DSCC before the major fundraising deadline we have at midnight tonight.

We have received a lot of individual donations leading up to today’s deadline. Those donations are the reason why this race has been rated a toss-up by major election experts.

But this moment requires more.

Early voting in Wisconsin began this week. And, a CNN poll that came out this week shows us trailing Ron Johnson by _just one point_ , proving we’re one of the most likely Democrats to flip a Senate seat from red to blue.

That’s why our opponents — Ron Johnson and Mitch McConnell’s dark-money groups — have spent $42 million on attack ads against me. They've been outspending us by a significant amount, and we can't risk losing any more ground in this race.

body:
Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to sell?
[Unsubscribe](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWnNsL4h9N)
[](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61007064:WnNsL4h9N:m:1:2532013465:3217802C51857196E9C5B780DE9E4531:r)
Friend,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $10, $25, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61007064:WnNsL4h9N:m:1:2532013465:3217802C51857196E9C5B780DE9E4531:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $10, $25, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/61007064:WnNsL4h9N:m:1:2532013465:3217802C51857196E9C5B780DE9E4531:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Friend. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence. My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

President Biden was elected based on a promise to reach across the aisle to find common ground with Republicans and that is a promise that he has largely failed to keep so far. Instead, he's pushed an agenda that is far too liberal for most Americans and it has yet again led to more political division. Soon our elected leaders will return to Washington and it'll be up to us to encourage them to put aside partisan politics and find common ground on the big issues that will require compromise to actually get meaningful reforms passed. **We've had some wins this year with several bipartisan accomplishments, but we need to keep up our efforts**. clean_body: | | | | One of the most dangerous things our troops overseas have to survive is burning trash. Burning trash? Yes. When deployed overseas, our fighting women and men often do not have access to most basic solid waste facilities, which forces service members to live next to burning trash – including dangerous metals, chemicals, rubber, and even defunct explosives. The result? These service members voluntarily risk their lives for our national security. They dodge bullets, evade IEDs, and then... get sick with cancer and respiratory illnesses because they are forced to live near burning trash. = One of my proudest votes in Congress came just this year, when I cast a yes vote for the Promise to Address Comprehensive Toxics Act (PACT) Act. The PACT Act is one of the largest increases in veterans' benefits in recent history. Congress passed this historic law on a bipartisan basis. When it comes to delivering for veterans, you can always count on me. The PACT Act makes history by expanding VA benefits to cover illnesses caused by these toxic burn pits. On top of that, veterans from every conflict from the Vietnam War to the post-9/11 era now have expanded eligibility for treatments for exposure to toxic substances like Agent Orange. When Donald Trump and his MAGA Republicans were in charge, they could not get this done, despite all their big talk. Our Democratic majority did, because Democrats know that we owe an enormous debt to the women and men who are willing to sacrifice their lives for our country — and we can deliver. = Rick | Express Donate: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: | = | = | = | = ---|---|---|--- | | Paid for and authorized by Citizens to Elect Rick Larsen. | This email was sent by . clean_body: We have a real chance to flip this seat in 12 days, but we need to keep up our grassroots momentum and send Ron Johnson packing. | | I’m a proud product of a union household. My mom was a public school teacher and my dad worked third shift on the assembly line. It was their good-paying union jobs that gave me a fair shot at achieving the American Dream. I hadn’t given much thought to getting involved in politics until I saw Barack Obama’s 2004 DNC speech. It was then that I realized I, too, had the power to change things in my community. And throughout my years as an organizer, state representative, lieutenant governor, and now as the Democratic nominee for U.S. Senate, I’ve never stopped fighting to give working people a seat at the table. But I’ve never done anything alone. It’s thanks to the faith and support that my parents, my community, and grassroots folks just like you have had in me. Now, I have to ask you to keep your faith. We have a real chance to flip this seat in just 12 days, but we need to keep up our grassroots momentum to send Ron Johnson packing. # **Cops Call on Josh Harder to Renounce "Defund Police" Pledge**
---
|
---
| STOCKTON, CA - According to reporting by the _Stockton Record_ and Federal Election Commission records, Congressional candidate Josh Harder accepted $5,000 from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez’s “Courage to Change” political action committee.* In order to receive funding, the _Record_ and _Fox News_ reports that candidates must fill out a questionnaire, which includes a pledge to “defund police.”

This PAC requires those who accept funds to say yes to the following pledge, "If running for a legislative position . . . do you pledge to vote for the following: A public safety strategy to reduce the annual budget for law enforcement and defense spending and shift those funds towards community resources and programs... .”**

It has been reported that at least four Congresspersons have thus far returned the contribution due to public pressure. We call on Mr. Harder to also return the money. And, if Harder took the pledge to defund police as has been reported, we call on him to denounce it. It is offensive to those of us fighting on the front lines to protect our community to have our federal representative pledge to vote for legislation that would require cuts to our ranks.

We are experiencing one of the worst crime waves in recent memory. We just experienced the terror of having a serial killer on the loose in our community. He was finally apprehended solely because of the good people in law enforcement.

Defunding police in other areas, like Los Angeles, New York, Chicago, Philadelphia, and Portland has proven to be a disastrous policy. Crime skyrocketed in these cities, forcing many to reverse their position. Defund police implies that police are the problem, not the criminals.

But soft-on-crime policies are the problem. We have seen in cities like San Francisco what happens when we reorder the justice system to favor the criminal over the victim. We do not want Josh Harder to bring San Francisco criminal justice polices to San Joaquin County.

We will be holding a “Fund the Police” rally at the San Joaquin County Correctional Officers Association headquarters at 131 D’Arcy Parkway in Lathrop tomorrow, Friday, October 28, at 5:30 PM. The rally is in support of San Joaquin County Supervisor Tom Patti, whom we have endorsed for Congress. Media is welcome to attend and ask questions.

subject: We've got the fighting spirit

body:
The time is running out for us to win this election and every single day between now and November 8 is an opportunity to defend choice, protect our democracy, and preserve the union way of life here in Pennsylvania.

Derek, it’s Josh Shapiro. We’re in the final stretch of this campaign with just _**12 days**_ until Election Day and just a few days until our _**very last**_ end-of-month fundraising deadline. Before I ask you to **[donate to the Big Fights Fund](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/53481671/375556575/-586780698?refcode=email_102722_resendeombffgotv_allactive&amount=5&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&refcode2=3da32eb4-4556-ed11-819c-002248258e08&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzZGEzMmViNC00NTU2LWVkMTEtODE5Yy0wMDIyNDgyNThlMDgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZWHlYK1Hr6NT5iZOg_OBWmeALSq-GylGDoYgsMQEPck=)** , I wanted to talk to you about the work that’s happening in every county across Pennsylvania to make sure we win. In every neighborhood from Erie to Philadelphia, there are staffers and volunteers making calls, texting, knocking on doors, and sharing social media posts to help Pennsylvanians make a plan to vote on November 8th. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

subject: I need your help

body:
#

Friends, it’s Mark. I need your help.
**Arizona is voting.** People have already started receiving and mailing back their ballots, and early voting locations are open. With the deadline for ballots to get mailed back just days away, time is running out to reach the voters we need.
The last time I reached out asking for volunteers, we filled over 200 phone banking shifts. That’s a huge accomplishment. If you helped us turn out voters last time around, thank you so, so much.
Since it went so well last time, I’m back for round two. We set a goal to fill 400 phone bank shifts through this email. Every day, every minute is critical right now, and volunteering is the best way to make sure people get out there and vote.
So, whether you had a blast last time or you want to give it a shot now, take a moment to sign up:
Make calls to voters to ensure they turn out to vote:
**[MAKE CALLS IN ENGLISH](https://act.markkelly.com/go/2033?source=em221027-4-30&t=2&akid=4509%2E6688874%2E4BKJx9)**
**[MAKE CALLS IN SPANISH](https://act.markkelly.com/go/2034?source=em221027-4-30&t=3&akid=4509%2E6688874%2E4BKJx9)**
Once you sign up, you'll receive an email and a call with the details for your volunteer shift.
We’re so close here, and I really appreciate your help.
See you out there!
— Mark
Or, if you can’t make a shift, you can always:
**[DONATE NOW](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-oct22.7U3p1A&refcode=em221027-4-30&t=4&akid=4509%2E6688874%2E4BKJx9)**

It’s safe to say that all eyes are on Georgia. **MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

**MY TWO WEEKS NOTICE:**
I've put my heart and soul into this election for nearly two years straight.

** 1\. I recruited the candidates**
-> I recruited 72 America First patriots to my Young Gun support program based on a series of hurdles and evaluations indicating their principled platforms, political readiness and winning strategy. Our candidates this cycle are the best of the best.

** 2\. I rallied our incumbents**
-> Our Republican conference has witnessed firsthand the destructive policies Pelosi has up her sleeve should she keep control of Congress... We will fight TOOTH and NAIL to halt her progressive peons, and restore American greatness.

** 3\. I put together our Commitment to America should we earn your vote**
-> We're going to build (1) an economy that's strong, (2) a nation that's safe, (3) a future that's built on freedom, and (4) a government that's accountable:

-> Rein in the IRS
-> Secure the Border
-> Fund the Police
-> Unleash American Energy
-> Secure our Elections
-> Curb Inflation & Spending
-> Pass the Parents Bill of Rights
-> Hold Joe Biden Accountable

But now it looks like we're going to come up just short of the funds we need to make it all happen on Election Day less than _**TWO WEEKS**_ from today...

I'll be disappointed. I'll be sad. But at least I'll know I gave it my all... All I ask is that you do the same.

**Can I count on you to make one last investment in the future of this country?**

This isn't about me. It's about you. It's about restoring freedom, safety, prosperity, and common sense to this great nation. Please, join me. Put some skin in the game so we can celebrate in less than **TWO WEEKS FROM TODAY:**

name: Ammon Bundy for Governor
subject: I Hate Saying It...But the Governor Is a Coward for Not Debating!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by [Ammon Bundy for Governor](https://www
body:
[View this Message in your Web Browser](https://www.votebundy.com/message?61a3bafc-e92e-4a96-8e9e-8073ef1b3583)
[VoteBundy.com/message?61a3bafc-e92e-4a96-8e9e-8073ef1b3583](https://www.votebundy.com/message?61a3bafc-e92e-4a96-8e9e-8073ef1b3583)
| | [](https://www.votebundy.com)
---
| Dear Peter, It is impossible to be both a good governor and a coward. You have to fight for your state every day. You have to wake up, asking where your state's next battle will land. It takes a fighting spirit. And sadly, we know Brad Little does not have that.Two gubernatorial debates were being planned in Idaho; one by KTVB and one by Idaho Public Television. Brad Little, Stephen Heidt and I were invited to debate in both of these. I was looking forward to the opportunity to provide more information to Idaho voters in these debates. However, I was soon informed that Brad Little refused the invitations to debate and give the people of Idaho a chance to see their candidates together and hear their responses in debate format. Though Brad Little declined, I was still willing to debate the Democrat Candidate, but Stephen Heidt also declined.Allow me a word on the outcomes of debates. Yes, logic and swiftness of mind, a winning and persuasive turn of phrase may win debates. They do NOT determine the outcome of administrations, and here's why not. Over the course of a governor's term, he has to show up every day to fight the good fight, and no matter who agreed with you last night, you have to win their support again day after day. Smooth talk and rapid wit can't do that. They can help, but they don't carry the day.Carrying the day takes, yes, indeed, real courage. But it also takes good policy and true leadership so that those good policies can be carried forward.On that note, consider, according to a statewide poll, 88% of Idahoans believe this is either a very important or the most important election in Idaho history. Because of Brad Little's cowardice, we face the reality of having to make our decision without the benefit of gubernatorial debates in either the Primary or the General election.So let's cut right to it. There is only one real reason that Brad Little declined debating in front of the people of Idaho...he does not want his actions to be exposed; actions that most Idahoans would not condone if they understood the path he is leading Idaho down. Sunlight is always the best disinfectant. Refusing to debate in a gubernatorial race is a significant disservice to the wonderful people of this great state.
Sincerely Yours,**Ammon Bundy**

subject: Congresswoman Cheney endorses Elissa
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Elissa Slotkin for Congress
body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221027&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq42022?refcode=email20221027&amount=28]
Team,
We wanted to share some big news. U.S. Rep. Liz Cheney (R-WY) has endorsed Elissa in her re-election campaign, the first time that Congresswoman Cheney has formally endorsed a Democrat.
The two Congresswomen serve together on the House Armed Services Committee and both have backgrounds in national security, with Cheney having previously served in the State Department. Cheney is the former Chair of the House Republican Conference and currently serves as Vice Chair of the House Select Committee on the January 6th Attack on the U.S. Capitol.
You can check out both of their statements below:
"I'm proud to endorse Elissa Slotkin. Serving together on the Armed Services Committee, I have come to know Elissa as a good and honorable public servant who works hard for the people she represents, wants what's best for the country, and is in this for the right reasons,” said Cheney. “While Elissa and I have our policy disagreements, at a time when our nation is facing threats at home and abroad, we need serious, responsible, substantive members like Elissa in Congress. I encourage all voters in the 7th district - Republicans, Democrats, and Independents - to support her in this election.”
"At a moment when the very heart of our democracy is being challenged, Rep. Cheney’s voice has been critical,” said Slotkin. “I’m grateful for her support in this race and I’m proud of the work we’ve done together to strengthen our national security and America’s role in the world. We all know that our country is going through a difficult moment right now. But throughout our history, two things have helped us weather times like these: engaged citizens and principled leaders, from both sides of the aisle. Rep. Cheney has shown tremendous leadership over the last two years, and while we certainly don’t agree on every issue, I look forward to welcoming her to Michigan’s 7th district next week to discuss the points where all Americans can leave politics aside and put our country above all else.”
We’re thrilled to welcome Rep. Cheney to Michigan next week to campaign with Elissa. Even though they may have real policy disagreements, both Elissa and Rep. Cheney know that our country needs two healthy parties to function – and some things, like patriotism, rise above partisan lines.

body:
We know our audience in Wisconsin, will you help us reach them? | | | Peter, With less than two weeks to go until Election Day, the polls are coming fast and furious. And while the noise from the pundits can seem deafening at times, here’s one meaningful trend we’ve been noticing in Wisconsin and other key races across the country: In one recent statewide poll, Mandela Barnes is tied at 47% with incumbent Republican Ron Johnson among registered voters. But when that same pollster narrowed the group to the voters they predicted are likely to actually vote, their margin favored Ron Johnson by 6 points. **What does this tell us? That we can win this race and other close ones like it — but only if we make sure our people come out to vote.** **[Right now we are on the ground, getting the word out about Mandela and mobilizing voters to head to the polls. Will you chip $4 in right now and help us reach more voters in Wisconsin and across the country?](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUWOAHLaINgldMLZn-WIG0JX9QbBSLe9JbeagPCJrlki8--fUIwwmvvL_Vftfbz2_guCowvOY8tw-346MtIB845HRjqFA0qyqDceTKHDv0nLoUsTY9LK1d-UE0U4StFhQxDuwT6kc0PphEGOHczaU0wiqULMh0grk9YJYS1byH0fStRrxh5grq97BxIKuS7u2Ski7Mk66N5KjIzUwd0uvyRwzfgD-STp22KtwI5wIdnnL2p7TFoQcVflkngXhcw1EfiZ7DWx7w89QSInh1HYRBlnhPvcO6IfCAEXKVyNHz43rrowQD02lUzHHI0Sojj8cT/3qn/gaUd9NilRnWCIdokpeXKpw/h0/-kth-iOCoIz9yBKgldkSlULYkxbUtRpq4zkWqpnm-oE)****** **[](https://an.workingfamilies.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953zfh-ljwx9RuYYFFGz5HiYUWOAHLaINgldMLZn-WIG0JX9QbBSLe9JbeagPCJrlki8--fUIwwmvvL_Vftfbz2_gXv6vLD9eiYljmoxpnuPPk3YJVFFB45pXKzDQ6FwmoKPkldvm41YrEbaPyaFVmpNoI8TIJv52XBF3upkwzRDzF2tHqKUlCvMKEa2p2j3PYfsPwbFi7BR09-kze4lahcQT3OcKxz3GJqB24_qnq5GzeR13LOIYHshH0gqhx0Lwp2pM1pTf_E7aXgXhhXw_ZT3bOxuQ6XagOhfrXgVnE1cH0htRTJe2bOvj9b9M_v-BzR7jN4VNz7KTokB823MOR6kL/3qn/gaUd9NilRnWCIdokpeXKpw/h1/KXlQ_IAxYglVNSk3y7IqfADqqYVMyHNquwc0D8q3ON0)** **The truth is that predicting "likely voters" is harder than ever for pollsters.** They’re trying to make turnout predictions based on things like enthusiasm and past voting history, while also # **Cops Call on Josh Harder to Renounce "Defund Police" Pledge**
---
|
---
| STOCKTON, CA - According to reporting by the _Stockton Record_ and Federal Election Commission records, Congressional candidate Josh Harder accepted $5,000 from Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez’s “Courage to Change” political action committee.* In order to receive funding, the _Record_ and _Fox News_ reports that candidates must fill out a questionnaire, which includes a pledge to “defund police.”

This PAC requires those who accept funds to say yes to the following pledge, "If running for a legislative position . . . do you pledge to vote for the following: A public safety strategy to reduce the annual budget for law enforcement and defense spending and shift those funds towards community resources and programs... .”**

It has been reported that at least four Congresspersons have thus far returned the contribution due to public pressure. We call on Mr. Harder to also return the money. And, if Harder took the pledge to defund police as has been reported, we call on him to denounce it. It is offensive to those of us fighting on the front lines to protect our community to have our federal representative pledge to vote for legislation that would require cuts to our ranks.

We are experiencing one of the worst crime waves in recent memory. We just experienced the terror of having a serial killer on the loose in our community. He was finally apprehended solely because of the good people in law enforcement.

Defunding police in other areas, like Los Angeles, New York, Chicago, Philadelphia, and Portland has proven to be a disastrous policy. Crime skyrocketed in these cities, forcing many to reverse their position. Defund police implies that police are the problem, not the criminals.

But soft-on-crime policies are the problem. We have seen in cities like San Francisco what happens when we reorder the justice system to favor the criminal over the victim. We do not want Josh Harder to bring San Francisco criminal justice polices to San Joaquin County.

We will be holding a “Fund the Police” rally at the San Joaquin County Correctional Officers Association headquarters at 131 D’Arcy Parkway in Lathrop tomorrow, Friday, October 28, at 5:30 PM. The rally is in support of San Joaquin County Supervisor Tom Patti, whom we have endorsed for Congress. Media is welcome to attend and ask questions.

Mike Lee

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. subject: Why your support matters
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/9a87c6df7427/saving-a-library-means-saving-a-community-9208161?e=0ba866af2d)
---
|
---
|

Hello Peter **Your support matters because this election will allow me to fight for investment in rural Minnesota and improve the quality of life for** _**everyone**_ – improve our housing, our childcare, and access to mental healthcare. I see a bright future for northern Minnesota and I won’t wallow in the fear and petty divisiveness that frequently grips politics these days. My key issue of housing isn’t a rich vs. poor or left vs. right kind of issue - everyone needs a place to call home if our community is to be strong. We simply need more housing investment across the full economic spectrum because we’re losing out on professionals who want to start businesses here, we’re losing out on jobs, and we’re creating a surplus of hopelessness among the poorest who also can’t find housing. This cornerstone problem goes beyond the typical political differences and targets the heart of many problems **facing all of us.** I’ll work with Republicans and Democrats to pass effective legislation for the benefit of the district. I’m not a partisan idealogue because **I will not sacrifice my community** in blind service to my caucus. However, **I will work harder than my opponent** to change the status quo on day one than my opponent did in six years who will only fiercely fight to conserve the status quo.**More importantly, I will actually do something about it**. It’s at the center of who I am as a person - I stand up and take action. When I saw too many people dying on Bemidji streets, I worked with other people to build a shelter. When I had a hard time matching people staying at our shelter up with the services they needed, I opened up a day center. I identify problems and I fix them. And I don’t do this alone – I accomplish my goal by working with people, often whom I don’t agree with ideologically. But we collaborate and we work on things where we have common cause and we put aside our ideological differences to argue some other time. **We need a champion for the district;** not a puppet following the talking points of a national party unhinged from the local reality facing our people. With your support, I will be your next state representative. Together, we will make our communities better and improve the quality of life for all rural Minnesotans. Hopefully, you can agree with my vision for the future. **I am the candidate who cares about our community and has the experience to go beyond party labels to accomplish goals important to voters.** Think of it like this. In the red corner you have Matt “More Gridlock” Grossell hardly working and in the blue corner you have Reed “Results Oriented” Olson working hard for you. Make your choice through early voting or on November 8th. In the meantime, please consider donating to magnify your vote’s impact and help us persuade more people to vote.It’s important that I ask you this because I’ve received $0 from corporate PACs. **My campaign is driven by donations from individuals like you.****And remember, you can get up to $50 of your donation back**. The Minnesota Political Contribution Refund Program (PCR) is designed to empower individual Minnesota voters to support campaigns with small donations. Individuals can receive up to a $50 refund and couples up to $100!

| Dear Fellow American,

Judicial Watch is doing what Congress and the liberal media won’t do...
...getting to the facts about the scandal of Biden family influence-peddling and corruption!
This scandal is in plain sight to see...but no one is prosecuting it except Judicial Watch!
[That’s why I urge you to help us with a special tax-deductible contribution today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60826&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
