---

You see, earlier this month we filed a Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) lawsuit against the U.S. Department of Justice for all records related to a key briefing by the FBI provided to members of the U.S. Senate who were investigating the business dealings of Hunter Biden, the son of President Joe Biden.

We filed the lawsuit after the corrupt Biden Justice Department "stonewalled" our original FOIA request for those records.

Senators Chuck Grassley (R-IA) and Ron Johnson (R-WI) are alleging that there was a scheme in place among certain FBI officials to undermine derogatory information connected to Hunter Biden by falsely suggesting it was disinformation... _and that is what we are investigating_.

The American people have a right to know the facts about whether the deeply compromised Justice Department and FBI _have been and still are_ engaged in a systematic effort to cover-up the sleazy business dealings of Hunter Biden...dealings that may have benefitted Joe Biden.

Fighting for the American people's "right to know" is what Judicial Watch is doing...and we can fight even more effectively if [if you will give us your financial support today!](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60826&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60826&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

Through our FOIA requests and lawsuits, Judicial Watch has uncovered significant information about Hunter Biden, who served on the board of directors for the Ukrainian energy firm Burisma Holdings despite having no previous experience in the energy industry.

And we released U.S. Secret Service records that show during the first five and a half years of the Obama administration Hunter Biden traveled to 29 foreign countries while receiving a Secret Service protective detail, including five trips to China.

Judicial Watch's work through the legal system and the courts forces the release of government documents that frequently even senior members of Congress cannot get their hands on.

And unlike the liberal media, we won't cover up that information...we release it to you and to the American people!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60826&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)
---

But every investigation we launch and every lawsuit we file comes with very real costs attached, especially when we are confronted by the deep pockets of the federal government and the determination of Deep State bureaucrats to protect their favored politicians.

So, please help us with your best gift today!

[Your special contribution now](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60826&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE) will help make sure that we can go the distance in the fight for transparency and accountability in government...

...including our fight for transparency in the matter of the Biden influence-peddling scandal and holding politicians like Joe Biden accountable!

[Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=60826&L=17813&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0xMzUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249TWF5JnV0bV90ZXJtPU5vbi1Eb25vcnMmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9Q01qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNE)

Thank you in advance for your generous support, and your commitment to helping Judicial Watch stand tall for the principle that "no one is above the law!"

Sincerely,

Tom Fitton
President

body:
[1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

I wanted to share with you a story about why I’m committed to running a
campaign that lifts up all Georgians. Where opportunity is available to
everyone — regardless of their background.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221027_B4_PersonalStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=15985%2E1862389%2Ernvbf- ]I hope you will read it, and then make your $5 donation
to ensure we can create a stronger Georgia that works for all Georgians.
Please, anything you’re able to give will make a real difference.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221027_B4_PersonalStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=15985%2E1862389%2Ernvbf- ]DONATE

In November 1994, I vied for a prize no one like no black person from
Mississippi had ever won before — one I had no road map for winning — the
Rhodes Scholarship.

I never even dreamed of applying for this prestigious award because it
seemed so far out of reach. I couldn't lose out to wealthier, more
prepared students of privilege if I simply didn't try. But if I tried and
failed, I would prove my deepest fears were correct - I could only reach
so high but no higher.

I mustered my courage, put in my bid and defied the odds. I became the
first black woman to be nominated for the Rhodes Scholarship by the state
of Mississippi. But my doubts continued. Now that I'd passed that first
hurdle, would I stumble at the finish line? When I shared this worry with
my parents as a reason to quit, my mom chastised me, “We never imagined,
from where we began, we would have a daughter who would have this
opportunity. You can’t fail, even if you don’t win. Because you’ve already
won the hardest part.”

A few weeks later, I learned I did not win the Rhodes Scholarship. The
loss devastated me, but in the attempt, I changed my life. This gave me
the courage to go on to Yale Law School, run for political office and
become the Minority Leader of the Georgia House of Representatives.

Because suddenly, I saw opportunity where I had never been brave enough to
look before — and where no one who looked like me had been.

I’m running for governor to open the doors of opportunity for people all
across our state, and to provide access to education, health care, housing
and a good living to all Georgians — regardless of their background or zip
code.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221027_B4_PersonalStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1004&akid=15985%2E1862389%2Ernvbf- ]I want to be clear: this is a fight we cannot afford to lose. That’s
why I’m counting on you to make a $5 donation to power our
campaign. Can you please chip in to my campaign right now, to seize this
moment and build a state where everyone has the opportunity to thrive?
Your continued support is critical for us in these final days of the
campaign if we’re going to win and get to work for Georgians.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/4397?refcode=sa_em_221027_B4_PersonalStory_S1_T1_SYA_30open&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1005&akid=15985%2E1862389%2Ernvbf- ]DONATE

Let’s get it done,

Stacey

Fellow American,

When my colleagues see me coming, they joke and say, [**"there’s Barr, so it must be something about horses, bourbon, Toyota, coal, or the University of Kentucky!"**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=baea062df4004ccb99dce57bfa37120a&_e=B6SemxdqwlzrWuuWI1Te4BT2GQRZgU3eqS_MKRYTpy8LAYQtQxzw7BN4gbLX6dNt6wDNuVnlL9-Ag8x40oTlNlalW3JRKFJX-VhQqE7CLer2mQkPXZZLaUPavt3Xc2FyyC08J2j0uhvA9UIEDOFK2yWRqRWW_MGeC-8UN2h1J5UpUs9siDBk4lfmEylVEVkcFxQNEHxGXUIQv66omrpjbR8DNKW3rgdO0_TLvVGVsyWApy5691N1L3d9rbWC4ekR3USXCHCb9Ao8fptAVRjk45G00YrtjPbL4BKNbIpQbN8u9i4wfLCaxG6kfgtKb3SAzPB6j1jh8jTggwqxVMqvpFDGjipO3OOHyWHuT7-CoTqttO7gKoI6_NOmo1a9XbzmtOO2TYgNO4nW5m6G3h_IRw%3D%3D)

_And they’re not wrong..._ I bleed Kentucky through and through. It’s where my family has always been, it’s the place that shaped me into the man I am, and it’s the Commonwealth that I’ve been so blessed to represent in Congress.

Now, towards the end of this email, I’m going to request something from you, but first, I want you to understand who I am, how I became the man I am, and what I’m hoping for my future and the future of my daughters.

Growing up, my sister was diagnosed with juvenile arthritis. Our family had to come together to support her treatment. _This taught me that family is the most important thing, compassion is essential, struggle is inevitable, and perseverance is necessary._

It also showed me the need for high-quality, affordable and accessible healthcare for families - [**which continues to be a top issue for me in Congress.**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=baea062df4004ccb99dce57bfa37120a&_e=B6SemxdqwlzrWuuWI1Te4BT2GQRZgU3eqS_MKRYTpy8LAYQtQxzw7BN4gbLX6dNt6wDNuVnlL9-Ag8x40oTlNlalW3JRKFJX-VhQqE7CLer2mQkPXZZLaUPavt3Xc2FyyC08J2j0uhvA9UIEDOFK2yWRqRWW_MGeC-8UN2h1J5UpUs9siDBk4lfmEylVEVkcFxQNEHxGXUIQv66omrpjbfJf-7U7wDUcTqX3_MKHjIlQdAPawB_yiQxfVLpOzRPAlFczcu0leRiC0ml-MyXftIGUml7yj_lxS0za5SjXUr6NdQuheopFCpb95cc7OjMG3-uyHS1TeokbVBA8bsVkDtx0qZ0o7CpJy5lI1XVCdMjiFB9ps-8IuW_0v2tEZTE3)

My love for Kentucky met my interest in politics when I first interned in Washington in college. The ability to work on and fight for legislative policies that helped conservative causes was so rewarding.

Ultimately, I took a chance and ran for Congress in my hometown of Lexington against an incumbent Democrat and lost by 647 votes in one of the closest races in the country. But I recalled the lessons I learned as a child, and I persevered. Two years later I ran again and I was elected. [**Since being in Congress, I’ve fought hard for issues that actually matter to families like tax cuts, American energy, and affordable, high-quality healthcare options.**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=baea062df4004ccb99dce57bfa37120a&_e=B6SemxdqwlzrWuuWI1Te4BT2GQRZgU3eqS_MKRYTpy8LAYQtQxzw7BN4gbLX6dNt6wDNuVnlL9-Ag8x40oTlNlalW3JRKFJX-VhQqE7CLer2mQkPXZZLaUPavt3Xc2FyyC08J2j0uhvA9UIEDOFK2yWRqRWW_MGeC-8UN2h1J5UpUs9siDBk4lfmEylVEVkcFxQNEHxGXUIQv66omrpjbfJf-7U7wDUcTqX3_MKHjIlnEXb83aFVlp1eM2FDl5KJMXsVk5cpjBYUxSLbvXGXY44YWOu3Ki5KY30GFvrfDNVFTIHq3tFg7Wlz5Xnihr0LlbQk9mk6v54yH_h8r6ssSo7NpUZcebd4adZVCxMAyZMKGF3i4Y1w0RgX5js5otSH)

As the father of two young girls, I’ve tried to instill in my daughters the same lessons that my parents taught me as a child: compassion, perseverance, and determination.

[](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=baea062df4004ccb99dce57bfa37120a&_e=B6SemxdqwlzrWuuWI1Te4BT2GQRZgU3eqS_MKRYTpy8LAYQtQxzw7BN4gbLX6dNt6wDNuVnlL9-Ag8x40oTlNlalW3JRKFJX-VhQqE7CLer2mQkPXZZLaUPavt3Xc2FyyC08J2j0uhvA9UIEDOFK2yWRqRWW_MGeC-8UN2h1J5UpUs9siDBk4lfmEylVEVkcFxQNEHxGXUIQv66omrpjbfJf-7U7wDUcTqX3_MKHjIn3LhxQwaY_d7DVH05QbhFZBacpKLsAH9ex8-Vo_VXCCjAdc_3KDRYP0In7ZGlp8074rLu6TZPXweHzlsm4rzi85Q0oI9zKc2_NyCpgv0mw6odvP2YC_vDbQPpe_TI2wrvYgyuHk5n6NEHX1DMKkcUe)

I take my role as a father very seriously, as do I take my commitment to Kentucky and to America. [**But Fellow American, what is happening in our country is beyond concerning - it goes against everything I believe in.**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=baea062df4004ccb99dce57bfa37120a&_e=B6SemxdqwlzrWuuWI1Te4BT2GQRZgU3eqS_MKRYTpy8LAYQtQxzw7BN4gbLX6dNt6wDNuVnlL9-Ag8x40oTlNlalW3JRKFJX-VhQqE7CLer2mQkPXZZLaUPavt3Xc2FyyC08J2j0uhvA9UIEDOFK2yWRqRWW_MGeC-8UN2h1J5UpUs9siDBk4lfmEylVEVkcFxQNEHxGXUIQv66omrpjbfJf-7U7wDUcTqX3_MKHjIlSw9roMU_itJ1h7eomXn1fVhvlA3CZ7cf8_QN8CDZRstn5eLXCP7DJgaJD69xjZtZ17b-IIRMpxgG2_MZ7gJriBkMdB4V821I1e8T_V9UysZJFVdxZBxkb5DWXW2gJLRoAIpzbVYV-Ilxmb4okTeo_)

_Open borders, a failing economy, a massive energy crisis, un-elected bureaucrats ruling our Nation, suppression of free speech..._

This is not the country I want to pass on to my children.

Thank you for reading this far, I wanted to tell you more about me and my WHY. Why day in and day out I’m working towards a better future for all of us. Now, I have an important ask for you.

But it is simple: [**I need your financial support to secure this seat and take back the House from the Democrats, who are trying to destroy the country we know and love. I hate to ask, but it’s our children’s futures on the line here.**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=baea062df4004ccb99dce57bfa37120a&_e=B6SemxdqwlzrWuuWI1Te4BT2GQRZgU3eqS_MKRYTpy8LAYQtQxzw7BN4gbLX6dNt6wDNuVnlL9-Ag8x40oTlNlalW3JRKFJX-VhQqE7CLer2mQkPXZZLaUPavt3Xc2FyyC08J2j0uhvA9UIEDOFK2yWRqRWW_MGeC-8UN2h1J5UpUs9siDBk4lfmEylVEVkcFxQNEHxGXUIQv66omrpjbfJf-7U7wDUcTqX3_MKHjIk76bGCN-1JwLK8JENUA8mngIx2Z21eJ6Xfmo103wPI-ubjY0odttTIsHkTOqE1rQbBE3Kn8W5HE9aPtup6O35XHk2MaNBaefSycRzzu4pebBA_EvAH6Q_Gtjl3hIq52UBxryVg4b5Y2qrhyODBik0X)

[** HELP ANDY SAVE AMERICA >>**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=baea062df4004ccb99dce57bfa37120a&_e=B6SemxdqwlzrWuuWI1Te4BT2GQRZgU3eqS_MKRYTpy8LAYQtQxzw7BN4gbLX6dNt6wDNuVnlL9-Ag8x40oTlNlalW3JRKFJX-VhQqE7CLer2mQkPXZZLaUPavt3Xc2FyyC08J2j0uhvA9UIEDOFK2yWRqRWW_MGeC-8UN2h1J5UpUs9siDBk4lfmEylVEVkcFxQNEHxGXUIQv66omrpjbfJf-7U7wDUcTqX3_MKHjInY65b0lFyo-o6f8wPdbLZdH6hdD9UOcPKDpM3XAhvfPcQVs41rkmd-IzGSpAhRg1drBtKelGaCFFF4E1sH9z2YUc5aX-1wv8WrNc8uMUpOVe99a7ND38db1baoruGPuKfm-saUFsgqwvZqtr35E9zt)
I know better than anyone, that struggle is inevitable - that we are all bound to face it. But the struggles that you are dealing with because of self-serving Democrats in Washington is a choice, one made by those who don’t care about you.

I have a commitment to my family, to Kentucky, and to this country to give the next generation a chance at a future, not to hand down a bunch of crises. [**Democrats in DC have sold out our children’s future, which is why I need your help to put the majority back in the hands of Republicans and stop this nonsense. Can I count on your support?**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=baea062df4004ccb99dce57bfa37120a&_e=B6SemxdqwlzrWuuWI1Te4BT2GQRZgU3eqS_MKRYTpy8LAYQtQxzw7BN4gbLX6dNt6wDNuVnlL9-Ag8x40oTlNlalW3JRKFJX-VhQqE7CLer2mQkPXZZLaUPavt3Xc2FyyC08J2j0uhvA9UIEDOFK2yWRqRWW_MGeC-8UN2h1J5UpUs9siDBk4lfmEylVEVkcFxQNEHxGXUIQv66omrpjbfJf-7U7wDUcTqX3_MKHjImpSfGtgN7pfl1OeR-KQVztWfJqmJscdgzTrN3SqPyNV6NVxGLPQFMD_rCiA3MZIzOQX2l-IaaaPoJXZ-mF8V-ZGk1cY_MWmTf-xm68DZhs4KGViKTX_XWDqWO4aY0C1hGWqY5LZXGRKIWMUOcNW7bp)

Team – we have only TWELVE DAYS until Election Day, and our race is getting tougher by the second. These donations keep us running, keep us reaching voters, and keep our conservative message STRONG. I so appreciate all you've done to support us so far. I can't wait for the moment on the night of November 8th when all of our hard work comes to fruition, and I can celebrate with ALL of you -- and get right to work. [**BREAKING NEWS: Senator Rick Scott endorses James Judge for Congress against Kathy Castor**](https://judgepr.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1f416ce0ac5ddfd320ec0ff6b&id=aeaf60c83c&e=00028e5542)
TAMPA, Fla. – Senator Rick Scott, who also served as the 45th governor of Florida, endorsed James Judge, the Republican nominee in the race for Florida’s 14th Congressional District on Thursday.“I encourage everyone in the 14th Congressional District to vote for James Judge,” Scott said. “He will help Republicans take back the House and fire Pelosi! I’m proud to endorse James!”Judge is facing incumbent Democrat and career politician, Kathy Castor, who has been in office since 2006.“I am absolutely grateful to Senator Scott for his endorsement and support of me and this campaign,” said Judge. “I’m rarely at a loss for words, but I can’t adequately describe how much of an honor it is to have the former governor and current senator of my home state give me his endorsement. Thank you, Senator Scott!”On Aug. 23, Judge won his primary election by 24 points, despite being outspent 10-to-one by his closest competitor.Judge has earned the endorsement of several prominent figures and organizations.They include:· Congressman Brian Mast (R-FL)· Congressman Paul Gosar (R-AZ)· Congressman Ted Yoho (R-FL) retired· Clearwater Mayor Frank Hibbard· Florida Police Benevolent Association· Pinellas County Sheriff Bob Gualtieri· The Tampa Police Benevolent Association· Pinellas County Sheriff Jim Coats (retired)· Associated Builders and Contractors Florida Gulf Coast· The Community Patriots Tampa· Republican strategist Roger Stone· Chris Chambers, former Congressional candidate and community leader· Matt Becker, small business owner, former SBA White House Deputy Chief, and former Congressional Candidate**About James Judge:
** Judge, a Tampa Bay area native, is the Republican nominee for Florida’s 14th Congressional District. Judge graduated from Eckerd College in St. Petersburg and was deployed to Iraq in support of Operation Iraqi Freedom while serving in the U.S. Coast Guard. Additionally, he served in Kabul, Afghanistan as a spokesman for the U.S. Department of Defense from 2010 until 2011 under General David Petraeus. He now owns Judge Public Relations, a Tampa-based PR firm and marketing agency with clients worldwide.Judge is married to his wife Danielle, who is also a small business owner in Hillsborough County. The Judges are avid animal lovers and together, they have four dogs, three cats, two horses and 10 chickens. Judge is a proud member of the National Rifle Association, Veterans of Foreign Wars, the American Legion, the Tampa Propeller Club and the Coastal Conservation Association. The Judges are also long-time, active members of Idlewild Baptist Church in Tampa.

Election Day is just 12 days away, and we have a lot of work to do in California.

And let me remind you, California is not some small, isolated state. We are the richest state in the United States, the most populous and most diverse. We are a state with almost 9 million people of reproductive age.

clean_body: I can’t overstate how important this upcoming election is. | | | Peter, I’ve served my country in the Navy, at NASA, and now in the Senate. No matter where I’ve been or what I was doing, I’ve always used science, data, and facts to make tough decisions. And right now, the facts tell me that we’re in trouble. National Republicans are attacking the right to abortion, denying the devastating impact climate change is having on our planet, and spreading misinformation about the integrity of our elections nationwide. But I refuse to let them win. I didn’t spend more than 54 days in space observing the damage climate change is wreaking on our planet just for far-right extremists to deny the truth and refuse to take action. I think our leaders should follow the facts, listen to the science, and act decisively — = I didn’t serve 25 years in the Navy just for Republicans to threaten our country from within by sowing doubt and misinformation about the integrity of our elections. Our leaders should respect the will of the voters and free and fair elections — = Science, data, and facts have helped me solve some of the most difficult challenges in my life. As a devout member of the church and a trusted physician within my community, I can promise that I will selflessly represent you in Congress. It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet. | [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=d210208bc3254189bcbb6c71440dd63a&_e=aR8HMwk7vwXyb9RXb4wG5sfPQAjY6GOlbuC4Klh0jl24aD490TKwWVlYWJ8_4LRNRo1lepjz0oH-bqvRlPkgghTba9HTXKB3KzmEUa2U_rYHvVzmPQH6YrZNwc5f6IxrO7neKUChw-zljo1xmNvylC8ZDpkZ0aFMjeoHADtZzfqp0TnZxVjfcV-xw2pjYawlKjwieuMOSG-fXqHub9uTUKsfAbiaY3M6dI1tlVLrShYVuNrpaMjKcvE64ZlfSs1vh1qO-mv5x6ZPB5-k_TVMWZ_wYT0FL9Nb1S9JMDaHKqTGtVtQjgr64GwUKse50xOdw6QIAu1v0rgdrBTW6g2a-g%3D%3D)

---
Peter,

Do you know _why_ I decided to become a doctor?

It’s because I knew that many people across the world and within our great country **desperately needed help**. I truly believe that God called on me to assist others during their times of hardship because he knew that I could carry the burdens of those I deliver aid to, improving their lives tremendously.

As a result, the past 35 years of my life have been spent in the medical field.

I graduated magna cum laude from Davidson College in 1985 and then graduated with honors from the UNC School of Medicine. I completed a surgical residency in Urology and Renal Transplantation at the University of Kentucky in Lexington and then opened up my own practice in Greenville, North Carolina, after moving there with my wife over 20 years ago.

I’ve traveled far and wide to places such as India, several parts of Africa, Nicaragua and Haiti as a Medical Missionary, serving both God and people from all walks of life. During this time, I was fortunate enough to meet Mother Teresa, who further inspired me to serve those in need.

My endeavors to lend a helping hand did not stop there. When Congressman Walter B. Jones, Jr. passed away in 2019 after 22 years of service and North Carolina was left without someone to represent their needs, **I felt called on to step up**.

For the past three years, I have been blessed to be able to serve the great people of North Carolina in Congress. Although this journey is a new one, I have learned it is not so different from working in the medical field. _**People want someone to care about their needs and take action to fix the issues that are causing them pain.**_

I excel as a congressman because I know how to take people’s problems into account, and work with individuals toward finding a solution that will result in them feeling great and living prosperously.

It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, _but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet_. I wish to proceed with my duties and continue work on issues that are important to you.

In order for me to fulfill my earthly responsibility and keep North Carolina on course for prosperity, I must implore you to do something for me. [**Will you please stand behind me in solidarity with your financial support?**](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=d210208bc3254189bcbb6c71440dd63a&_e=aR8HMwk7vwXyb9RXb4wG5sfPQAjY6GOlbuC4Klh0jl24aD490TKwWVlYWJ8_4LRNRo1lepjz0oH-bqvRlPkgghTba9HTXKB3KzmEUa2U_rYHvVzmPQH6YrZNwc5f6IxrO7neKUChw-zljo1xmNvylC8ZDpkZ0aFMjeoHADtZzfp5lPXPMQvn_W3FvLZV-Vh8n9DrlBwzpPcafVl4N5c6hBKQUYH1wgd7S8PhlQSWk-4Uy2W3HTYYBfcX-3z1F-1zG_x9a0bWbv9m9lhfS6GkXzeXUm_N6H8dp2ReZb2pi0PddBtoV2O5Sk2UVIukhikngGoANOOMac-MB5t8RdD7cw%3D%3D)

clean_body: As a devout member of the church and a trusted physician within my community, I can promise that I will selflessly represent you in Congress. It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet. | Peter, Do you know why I decided to become a doctor? It’s because I knew that many people across the world and within our great country desperately needed help. I truly believe that God called on me to assist others during their times of hardship because he knew that I could carry the burdens of those I deliver aid to, improving their lives tremendously. As a result, the past 35 years of my life have been spent in the medical field. I graduated magna cum laude from Davidson College in 1985 and then graduated with honors from the UNC School of Medicine. I completed a surgical residency in Urology and Renal Transplantation at the University of Kentucky in Lexington and then opened up my own practice in Greenville, North Carolina, after moving there with my wife over 20 years ago. I’ve traveled far and wide to places such as India, several parts of Africa, Nicaragua and Haiti as a Medical Missionary, serving both God and people from all walks of life. During this time, I was fortunate enough to meet Mother Teresa, who further inspired me to serve those in need. My endeavors to lend a helping hand did not stop there. When Congressman Walter B. Jones, Jr. passed away in 2019 after 22 years of service and North Carolina was left without someone to represent their needs, I felt called on to step up. For the past three years, I have been blessed to be able to serve the great people of North Carolina in Congress. Although this journey is a new one, I have learned it is not so different from working in the medical field. People want someone to care about their needs and take action to fix the issues that are causing them pain. I excel as a congressman because I know how to take people’s problems into account, and work with individuals toward finding a solution that will result in them feeling great and living prosperously. It has been a privilege to represent the wonderful people of North Carolina, but I’m not ready to give up on this position just yet. I wish to proceed with my duties and continue work on issues that are important to you. In order for me to fulfill my earthly responsibility and keep North Carolina on course for prosperity, I must implore you to do something for me. I am aware that what I’m asking may be difficult, but it is necessary – especially if we want to continue our hard work. It’s my calling to serve you, but As a devout member of the church and a trusted physician within my community, I can promise that I will selflessly represent you in Congress. I will continue to advocate for your needs and champion North Carolina values – just as I advocate for my patients and for the word of God. Team –

I gave it all I had on the debate stage, and now, early voting is underway in Arizona. That means our window to reach the voters we need is closing.

I’m gonna keep working hard all the way to Election Day, but I’ll be honest: A lot of this depends on you.

This was always going to be one of the most expensive races in the country. But the amount of outside money coming into Arizona to boost Blake Masters and hurt my campaign is shocking – even for me. It feels like another super PAC or dark-money group is announcing another million-dollar TV ad every couple days.

And after Masters had his biggest platform yet at our debate, we’ve got to be able to set the record straight.

Especially after the NRSC reversed course and has decided to spend an additional SEVEN figures in Arizona between now and the election. It’s a sign that they are all-in on Masters and will do anything to close the gap in these final weeks.

I know I’ve asked a lot, team. But I really need your help, and the ball’s in your court now. This seat is at risk, and if we don’t hold onto it we’re likely to lose the Senate.

name: Cheri Beasley
subject: a crisis of justice
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
We could use more leaders in the Senate who see justice as the North Star.
#

As a public defender, judge and Chief Justice of North Carolina, I led with a commitment to integrity and justice and I saw firsthand how the laws handed down from Washington failed our families.
There is a crisis of justice in Washington. When I look at the extremism, corruption and gridlock, I know that we deserve better.
Republican politicians like Ted Budd want to ban abortion without exceptions. They threatened our democracy on January 6 by voting to overturn the 2020 election, and they vote to help corporate interests and the billionaires who fund their campaigns. But I refuse to let them win.
I didn’t spend my life defending the Constitution and fighting for justice to watch politicians and a politicized, extremist Supreme Court take away our fundamental rights. I think it’s time to end the filibuster to defend abortion rights and protect the right to vote — [**if you agree, will you donate $3?**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221027-3-T1&t=1&akid=2142%2E357359%2ERkDtqI)
I don’t believe corporate special interests should be allowed to rip off consumers to line their pockets. We are facing a global climate crisis and people are dying because they cannot afford the cost of prescription drugs while Big Oil and Big Pharma rake in record profits. That is not just, and our leaders should not be afraid to shake up such a broken status quo — [**will you donate $3 if you agree?**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221027-3-T1&t=2&akid=2142%2E357359%2ERkDtqI)
The pursuit of justice should not be a partisan issue. We should all want lower costs, protections for our Constitutional rights, and a livable planet and bright future for our children. It’s time we elect more Senators who will put politics aside and focus on delivering justice and real change for people.
[**This is what’s at stake in our race, and it could not be more important. So if you’re ready for new leadership for North Carolina, chip in $3 today to help us flip this seat and expand our majority.**](https://act.cheribeasley.com/go/2567?c0=cb-em-oct22.I3buyh&refcode=em221027-3-T1&t=3&akid=2142%2E357359%2ERkDtqI)

name: Vernon Robinson
subject: Last chance to buy radio ads to build on Trump legacy
body:
|
Peter \-- The democrat machine is up to its old tricks, running terrorist ads in order to spike black voter turnout. On urban contemporary radio in the critical I-85 corridor from Raleigh-Durham, through Greensboro to Charlotte, 8 to 10 ads an hour are running. The ads imply that Republicans are suppressing black votes, taking away the "right" to kill their babies, taking away medicare and social security, and stealing elections. Cheri Beasley's ad responds to our ads even thiugh they don't name her because our ads are dangerously cutting into her black base. I'm asking you to give so I can put these very effective ads up next week. Again, the ads are so effective in raising Budd's support and lowering black voter turnout that she felt she had to respond to ads that don't mention her. That's where you come in. By contributing to Black Americans Making America First today, you will do three things. **1\. You will help stop the Democrats from successfully running their spike the black vote strategy.** **2\. As black voters find out how radical Cheri Beasley is, many black voters will do one of two things, either vote for the Republicans or not vote at all.** **3\. You will continue to drive her on the defensive and if she is doing anything but running terrorist ads like "Vote Democratic or another black church will be bombed," she is off message.** We have run five ads running in North Carolina on 5 radio stations for four weeks. These ads include saving black babies, school choice, the border, public safety and inflation. The last week we will run the inflation ad because that is the top issue for black voters in North Carolina You can buy an ad to play this message to black voters. It costs $200 to buy a 60 second issue radio ad in Charlotte, $305 in Greensboro to $325 in Raleigh. We have $11,000 in hand. We expect to get another $10,000 from large contributors, but the last $4000 will have to come from donors like you. We need you to contribute now because we have to pay for the ads by noon tomorrow. `Please give $0 ``or whatever you can.` | [](https://www.blackamericansmaga.org/donate?e=305294bd7e656b520643df50a255d78c&utm_source=draftew&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=last_chance_legacy&n=1 "Please donate Today") [Please donate Today](https://www.blackamericansmaga.org/donate?e=305294bd7e656b520643df50a255d78c&utm_source=draftew&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=last_chance_legacy&n=1)

`Remember you can give an unlimited amount as either an American citizen or corporation.`
Thank you for stepping up before and thank you in advance for helping do the hard work of freedom with your donation today.
Vernon Robinson, Co-Founder Black Americans Making America First (formally known as Black Americans to re-elect the President)
PS. Help get our hard hitting ads up for another week asking black voters for their support because you know that nobody has ever made a sale without asking for the business. After years of neglect the only way to get black votes is to ask for them.

Growing up, smart, strong, and unconventional women were discouraged. When I ran for office, the South Carolina legislature was dominated by a Good Old Boys' Club and my opponent thought women shouldn’t be in politics. People thought I was too brown, too female, too young, too conservative, too principled. I said: Too bad.

Yesterday was not a good fundraising day, and that is putting it lightly. **If I’m being totally honest, it was the worst day of the month so far.**

**Just 26 people donated to the email that I sent out yesterday for a total of $390.** If you read the note yesterday morning, then you may recall that needed that email to raise $10,038– more than**_27 times what we wound up raising by the day’s end._**

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Hi, Peter.

Since Justice Democrats recruited Summer Lee, we helped her run a historic
campaign in PA-12, overcome the odds, and win the Democratic primary.
Right now we’re laser-focused on ensuring Summer gets elected on November
8.

In the last month alone, Super PACs have spent millions of dollars
attacking Summer and her campaign, and we’re only 12 days out from the
election.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/119221?refcode=em20221027-25771&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1001&akid=25771%2E1203867%2EsWSkRq ]Justice Democrats helped Summer build a people-powered movement from
the ground up, but now her grassroots campaign is up against millions.
With just days to go, can you split a $3 donation between JD
& Summer’s campaign?

In other election cycles this seat might be safe. But because of
manipulative Republican tactics and the corrupting influence of Super PAC
money, we’re up against two particularly difficult challenges:

1. Next door to PA-12 is PA-17, one of the most competitive House seats
in the country. Republicans have spent well millions in ads that
ostensibly attack the Democratic candidate in PA-17, but spend the
majority of the ad focusing on negatives about Summer Lee. These ads
have been on air on local TV in Pittsburgh for over a month.
2. Republicans are running a candidate named Mike Doyle - the same name
as the retiring Democrat who was Pittsburgh's Congressman for nearly
30 years. The campaign hears from confused voters every day who think
Summer is running against Democratic Congressman Mike Doyle. Further,
Republican Mike Doyle is doing everything he can to further sow
confusion, from never identifying as a Republican to misleading
robocalls.

We need your help to set the record straight and ensure voters know
Summer’s opponent is an anti-abortion, insurrection aligned, extreme
Republican.

With more financial resources, Summer’s campaign can use paid
communications and its field program to communicate with confused voters,
make sure they understand who is actually on the ballot and who is not,
and make sure they are hearing some positive messaging about Summer. There
are also crucial statewide elections in PA for Governor and Senate and
strong turnout in this district is crucial to ensuring statewide
Democratic candidates win their elections.

Justice Democrats and Summer’s team are working non-stop to share her
positive, people-first vision for PA-12 as we get out the vote. It’s never
been more important than in these last 12 days, but we urgently need to
raise funds to ensure voters hear Summer’s message.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/119221?refcode=em20221027-25771&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1002&akid=25771%2E1203867%2EsWSkRq ]Peter, it’s
now or never. Summer needs grassroots support if we're going to win on
November 8 — can you split a $3 donation between Justice
Democrats and Summer right now to help her win?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/119221?refcode=em20221027-25771&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1021&akid=25771%2E1203867%2EsWSkRq ]Contribute $3

Thank you for being in this fight with us and supporting Summer,

Alexandra Rojas

Executive Director

Justice Democrats

Do not worry if you cannot afford to make a contribution — we understand that
this is a difficult time. If you’re struggling, you can find a food bank
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/28883?t=1022&akid=25771%2E1203867%2EsWSkRq ]here. We appreciate everything you do to keep our movement strong.

Please stay informed and follow the most up-to-date recommendations from the
[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/24438?t=1023&akid=25771%2E1203867%2EsWSkRq ]Centers for Disease Control and your state public health department.

body:
| [ ](http://www.action4liberty.com/?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=did_you_know_about_election&n=1)

Peter \-- With less than two weeks to go until Election Day, **we are in an all-out war to EXPOSE Tyrant Tim Walz along with other lockdown politicians and save our way of life.** **REMEMBER:** _You will stay in your home until we can slow the spread. Only essential workers are allowed on the roads._ _This vaccine will end the pandemic, so roll up your sleeve or lose your job._ _Restaurants, gyms and churches will remain closed, but you can shop at Target or go to the liquor store._ I remember this so well. Do you? It doesn't matter what politicians, or political pundits, or the corporate media tell you, this election is about our FREEDOMS! A major injustice has occurred and you, me and millions of other people have risen up to take back our rights. **That's what on the ballot on November 8th!** We've been in the trenches, fighting against the Political Class Elites now for years over the most fundamental rights. You see, across Minnesota, the most hotly contested State House and Senate races all are razor thin. **Minnesota’s entire state government is up for grabs with radical socialists only needing to flip TWO seats to seize control of our weak-kneed Senate chamber.** And BILLIONAIRE Leftist donors are pouring over $1,000,000 in ads into our state to prop up Radical Far-Left candidates running for office! If we don’t fight back, I’m worried we’ll be staring straight at a total DISASTER – and we can’t let that happen. **That’s why Action 4 Liberty is just approved a massive education program to 100,000 Minnesotans from every corner of the state.** We're running hard-hitting digital ads and mailers in defense of our great freedoms and to EXPOSE radical leftists who are running for office in key legislative districts! During the second Tim Walz lockdown, six Democrats betrayed their voters, flipped their votes and started protecting Walz' Emergency Powers. Action 4 Liberty [started bringing pain](https://www.action4liberty.com/pressure_campaign?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=did_you_know_about_election&n=2) to these politicians. We knocked every door in their district. Now **Con Artist politicians like Julie Sandstede** are on the verge of a massive DEFEAT by her voters. All because you helped us expose her betrayals to voters. [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=did_you_know_about_election&n=3) Sandstede won by a mere 30 votes in 2020. In a little under two weeks, she'll lose by a WHOLE LOT MORE! But it wasn't only Sandstede who prolonged the damage Walz did to our liberties. Politicians Lislegard and Ecklund were by her side, voting against our freedoms. Action 4 Liberty has already contacted tens of thousands of voters informing them where candidates stand on issues. We're doing everything we can to inform people of what's at stake in November! But we need to more to ensure we don't suffer under the boot of Tyrant Tim Walz and his merry band of lockdown politicians. **So I’m asking for your IMMEDIATE financial support to FIGHT BACK against the Radical Left.** Believe me, the impact WILL be felt – just as the voices of American Patriots have been heard time and again throughout our nation’s history. With the future of Minnesota and our nation being decided in just two weeks, **it’s time to go bigger than ever before – it’s time to go MASSIVE.** It’s time to ensure that when the smoke clears from Election Day, you and I don’t wake up with the sting of regret wishing we could've done more. That’s why I’m counting on you to help me make a final push with the hardest-hitting, most devasting ad campaign blitz so far this cycle! **[With time ticking down on the clock to get this out the door, will you please dig deep and agree to a generous contribution of $250 or $100](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=did_you_know_about_election&n=4)?** I know that’s a tremendous amount to ask for. If $250 or $100 is too much, please agree to **[$75, $50 or at least $25](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=did_you_know_about_election&n=5)**. This is the final track. This is the last 100 yards before the dust settles and our very existence is at stake. It’s time to put everything on the line. Action 4 Liberty is going “all in,” will you go with me? **Please agree to your most generous contribution of $250, $100, $75, $50 or at least $25 right away.** With you in this with me, we WILL restore our freedoms! | [](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=did_you_know_about_election&n=6 "Donate") [Donate](https://www.action4liberty.com/donate?e=44f3e77e3a436673570805f6f24387d1&utm_source=action4liberty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=did_you_know_about_election&n=6)
